text:
Consumer Electronics Category Guideline > 1. Scope > CAT-001-C1 Covered Products

This guideline covers audio equipment, televisions and displays, computing hardware,
mobile devices, wearables, cameras, and consumer networking equipment. Products
containing lithium cells are additionally governed by SAF-003.

metadata.doc_title: Consumer Electronics Category Guideline

text:
Consumer Electronics Category Guideline > 2. Mandatory Category Attributes > CAT-001-C2 Required Attributes

In addition to the platform-wide mandatory set in CLS-003-C1, electronics listings shall
declare: input voltage range, plug type, connectivity standards supported, warranty
period in months, and whether the item is new, refurbished, or open-box.

metadata.doc_title: Consumer Electronics Category Guideline

text:
Consumer Electronics Category Guideline > 2. Mandatory Category Attributes > CAT-001-C3 Condition Declaration

Refurbished items shall declare the refurbisher and the functional test performed.
Open-box items shall state whether the original accessories are complete. Misdeclaring
condition is a Tier 1 defect.

metadata.doc_title: Consumer Electronics Category Guideline

text:
Consumer Electronics Category Guideline > 2. Mandatory Category Attributes > CAT-001-C4 Compatibility Claims

Claimed compatibility with a named third-party device shall be limited to devices the
seller has verified. Blanket claims such as "works with all smartphones" are prohibited
under CLS-002-C9.

metadata.doc_title: Consumer Electronics Category Guideline

text:
Consumer Electronics Category Guideline > 3. Electrical Safety > CAT-001-C5 Mains-Powered Product Approval

Any product with a mains connection requires the electrical goods category approval
described in CLS-006-C4. The approval application shall include the plug and adapter
specification for each storefront the product will be sold into.

metadata.doc_title: Consumer Electronics Category Guideline

text:
Consumer Electronics Category Guideline > 3. Electrical Safety > CAT-001-C6 Plug Compatibility Labelling

Where the supplied plug does not match the destination storefront's socket standard, the
listing shall state this prominently in the first bullet feature and shall state whether
an adapter is included. Omission is a Tier 1 safety-labelling defect.

metadata.doc_title: Consumer Electronics Category Guideline

text:
Consumer Electronics Category Guideline > 3. Electrical Safety > CAT-001-C7 Energy Labelling

Displays, and any product subject to a statutory energy label in the storefront
jurisdiction, shall carry the energy efficiency class attribute and an image of the
energy label as a secondary product image.

metadata.doc_title: Consumer Electronics Category Guideline

text:
Consumer Electronics Category Guideline > 4. Wireless and Radio > CAT-001-C8 Radio Equipment Declaration

Products transmitting on licensed or licence-exempt radio spectrum shall declare the
frequency bands used and the maximum radiated power, and shall hold the applicable radio
equipment conformity marking for the storefront jurisdiction.

metadata.doc_title: Consumer Electronics Category Guideline

text:
Consumer Electronics Category Guideline > 4. Wireless and Radio > CAT-001-C9 Signal Boosters and Jammers

Signal jammers are prohibited under CLS-006-C2. Cellular signal boosters are restricted
and require carrier authorisation evidence with the category approval.

metadata.doc_title: Consumer Electronics Category Guideline

text:
Consumer Electronics Category Guideline > 4. Wireless and Radio > CAT-001-C10 Data and Privacy Features

Products with a camera or always-on microphone shall disclose that capability in the
bullet features and shall state whether recordings are stored on-device or in a cloud
service.

metadata.doc_title: Consumer Electronics Category Guideline

text:
Apparel, Footwear and Accessories Category Guideline > 1. Scope > CAT-002-C1 Covered Products

This guideline covers clothing, footwear, bags, belts, hats, and fashion accessories.
Children's sleepwear carries additional flammability obligations under SAF-005.

metadata.doc_title: Apparel, Footwear and Accessories Category Guideline

text:
Apparel, Footwear and Accessories Category Guideline > 2. Mandatory Category Attributes > CAT-002-C2 Required Attributes

Apparel listings shall declare: fabric composition by percentage, care instructions,
size system, size value, colour, and target gender or unisex designation.

metadata.doc_title: Apparel, Footwear and Accessories Category Guideline

text:
Apparel, Footwear and Accessories Category Guideline > 2. Mandatory Category Attributes > CAT-002-C3 Fibre Composition Accuracy

Fibre composition shall total exactly 100 percent and shall be stated to the nearest
whole percent. Terms such as "cotton blend" without percentages do not satisfy this
clause and are an attribute defect.

metadata.doc_title: Apparel, Footwear and Accessories Category Guideline

text:
Apparel, Footwear and Accessories Category Guideline > 2. Mandatory Category Attributes > CAT-002-C4 Size Chart Requirement

Every apparel listing shall include a size chart image mapping the declared size system
to body measurements in both centimetres and inches. Listings without a size chart are
ineligible for featured placement.

metadata.doc_title: Apparel, Footwear and Accessories Category Guideline

text:
Apparel, Footwear and Accessories Category Guideline > 3. Labelling > CAT-002-C5 Physical Care Label

The supplied garment shall carry a permanent physical label stating fibre composition,
care symbols, and country of origin. The listing shall not contradict the physical
label; where they differ, the listing is the defect.

metadata.doc_title: Apparel, Footwear and Accessories Category Guideline

text:
Apparel, Footwear and Accessories Category Guideline > 3. Labelling > CAT-002-C6 Country of Origin Statement

Country of origin shall be declared per CLS-004-C9 and shall match the physical label.

metadata.doc_title: Apparel, Footwear and Accessories Category Guideline

text:
Apparel, Footwear and Accessories Category Guideline > 3. Labelling > CAT-002-C7 Material Claims

Claims such as "genuine leather", "organic cotton", "recycled polyester", or "vegan
leather" require substantiation under CLS-002-C8. Organic and recycled claims require a
named certification scheme and certificate number.

metadata.doc_title: Apparel, Footwear and Accessories Category Guideline

text:
Apparel, Footwear and Accessories Category Guideline > 4. Restricted Materials > CAT-002-C8 Prohibited Animal Materials

Products containing fur from cat or dog species, or any material from a species listed
under an international trade convention appendix, are prohibited.

metadata.doc_title: Apparel, Footwear and Accessories Category Guideline

text:
Apparel, Footwear and Accessories Category Guideline > 4. Restricted Materials > CAT-002-C9 Azo Dyes and Chemical Limits

Textiles shall not release the restricted aromatic amines listed in RSR-003. Compliance
evidence may be requested for any dyed textile.

metadata.doc_title: Apparel, Footwear and Accessories Category Guideline

text:
Apparel, Footwear and Accessories Category Guideline > 4. Restricted Materials > CAT-002-C10 Drawstrings in Childrenswear

Children's upper-body garments in sizes up to 140 centimetres shall not have functional
drawstrings in the hood or neck area. This is a Tier 1 safety defect.

metadata.doc_title: Apparel, Footwear and Accessories Category Guideline

text:
Toys and Juvenile Products Category Guideline > 1. Scope and Approval > CAT-003-C1 Covered Products

This guideline covers toys, games, and juvenile products including strollers, cots,
highchairs, carriers, and child restraint accessories, intended for users under 14
years of age.

metadata.doc_title: Toys and Juvenile Products Category Guideline

text:
Toys and Juvenile Products Category Guideline > 1. Scope and Approval > CAT-003-C2 Category Approval Mandatory

Listing in this category requires the children's toys and juvenile products approval
under CLS-006-C4. The application shall include a current toy safety test report from an
accredited laboratory for each distinct product.

metadata.doc_title: Toys and Juvenile Products Category Guideline

text:
Toys and Juvenile Products Category Guideline > 2. Mandatory Category Attributes > CAT-003-C3 Required Attributes

Listings shall declare: minimum age in months, maximum age in months where applicable,
whether the item contains small parts, whether it contains magnets, battery type and
count, and the applicable safety standard reference.

metadata.doc_title: Toys and Juvenile Products Category Guideline

text:
Toys and Juvenile Products Category Guideline > 2. Mandatory Category Attributes > CAT-003-C4 Age Grading Consistency

The declared minimum age shall match the age grading printed on the physical packaging.
A conflict between the listing and the packaging is a Tier 1 defect.

metadata.doc_title: Toys and Juvenile Products Category Guideline

text:
Toys and Juvenile Products Category Guideline > 3. Safety Labelling > CAT-003-C5 Small Parts Warning

Any toy intended for children under 36 months that contains or can generate a small part
shall not be listed for that age group. Where the toy is intended for children over 36
months and contains small parts, the listing shall display the choking hazard warning
required by SAF-002-C4 in the first bullet feature and on the primary image's
accompanying label image.

metadata.doc_title: Toys and Juvenile Products Category Guideline

text:
Toys and Juvenile Products Category Guideline > 3. Safety Labelling > CAT-003-C6 Magnet Hazard

Toys containing loose or detachable magnets exceeding the magnetic flux threshold in
SAF-002-C6 are prohibited for users under 14 and require the ingestion hazard warning
where permitted at all.

metadata.doc_title: Toys and Juvenile Products Category Guideline

text:
Toys and Juvenile Products Category Guideline > 3. Safety Labelling > CAT-003-C7 Button Cell Batteries

Products containing button or coin cells shall comply with the secured-compartment and
warning requirements in SAF-003-C7. This applies to toys, lights, and novelty items
regardless of the primary category.

metadata.doc_title: Toys and Juvenile Products Category Guideline

text:
Toys and Juvenile Products Category Guideline > 3. Safety Labelling > CAT-003-C8 Cords and Strangulation

Juvenile products with cords, straps, or loops shall state the maximum free cord length
and shall carry the strangulation warning where the free length exceeds 220 millimetres.

metadata.doc_title: Toys and Juvenile Products Category Guideline

text:
Toys and Juvenile Products Category Guideline > 4. Marketing Restrictions > CAT-003-C9 Prohibited Developmental Claims

Claims that a toy improves intelligence, accelerates development, or produces a
measurable cognitive outcome are prohibited absent a substantiating study identified in
the listing.

metadata.doc_title: Toys and Juvenile Products Category Guideline

text:
Toys and Juvenile Products Category Guideline > 4. Marketing Restrictions > CAT-003-C10 Imagery Restrictions

Product images shall not depict a child using the product in a manner contrary to the
instructions or without required supervision.

metadata.doc_title: Toys and Juvenile Products Category Guideline

text:
Food, Beverage and Dietary Supplements Category Guideline > 1. Scope and Approval > CAT-004-C1 Covered Products

This guideline covers packaged food, beverages, dietary supplements, sports nutrition,
and infant formula. Dietary supplements require the category approval in CLS-006-C4.

metadata.doc_title: Food, Beverage and Dietary Supplements Category Guideline

text:
Food, Beverage and Dietary Supplements Category Guideline > 1. Scope and Approval > CAT-004-C2 Infant Formula Restriction

Infant formula for children under 12 months is a restricted product requiring a separate
approval and may not be listed by third-party sellers without manufacturer
authorisation evidence.

metadata.doc_title: Food, Beverage and Dietary Supplements Category Guideline

text:
Food, Beverage and Dietary Supplements Category Guideline > 2. Mandatory Category Attributes > CAT-004-C3 Required Attributes

Listings shall declare: net quantity, ingredient list in descending order by weight,
allergen declaration, nutrition information per 100 grams or 100 millilitres, storage
instructions, and the shelf-life or best-before basis.

metadata.doc_title: Food, Beverage and Dietary Supplements Category Guideline

text:
Food, Beverage and Dietary Supplements Category Guideline > 2. Mandatory Category Attributes > CAT-004-C4 Allergen Declaration

The allergen declaration is mandatory and shall name every regulated allergen present,
including allergens present through cross-contamination where the manufacturer declares
a precautionary statement. Omitting a present allergen is a Tier 1 safety defect and
results in immediate suppression.

metadata.doc_title: Food, Beverage and Dietary Supplements Category Guideline

text:
Food, Beverage and Dietary Supplements Category Guideline > 2. Mandatory Category Attributes > CAT-004-C5 Ingredient Image Requirement

A legible image of the physical ingredient and nutrition panel is a mandatory secondary
image under IMG-004-C3. Listings without it are suppressed.

metadata.doc_title: Food, Beverage and Dietary Supplements Category Guideline

text:
Food, Beverage and Dietary Supplements Category Guideline > 3. Shelf Life > CAT-004-C6 Minimum Remaining Shelf Life

Items shall be dispatched with at least 60 percent of total shelf life remaining, or 90
days remaining, whichever is shorter. Dispatching below this threshold is a fulfilment
defect.

metadata.doc_title: Food, Beverage and Dietary Supplements Category Guideline

text:
Food, Beverage and Dietary Supplements Category Guideline > 3. Shelf Life > CAT-004-C7 Date Marking

The listing shall state whether the date mark is a "use by" or "best before" date.
Items past a "use by" date may not be listed or dispatched under any circumstance.

metadata.doc_title: Food, Beverage and Dietary Supplements Category Guideline

text:
Food, Beverage and Dietary Supplements Category Guideline > 4. Claims > CAT-004-C8 Prohibited Health Claims

Claims that a food or supplement treats, prevents, cures, or diagnoses a disease are
prohibited without exception. This includes implied claims through imagery, product
naming, or customer testimonial excerpts in the description.

metadata.doc_title: Food, Beverage and Dietary Supplements Category Guideline

text:
Food, Beverage and Dietary Supplements Category Guideline > 4. Claims > CAT-004-C9 Permitted Nutrition Claims

Nutrition claims such as "high in fibre" or "source of protein" are permitted only where
the product meets the quantitative condition defined in the storefront jurisdiction's
nutrition claim register, and the listing states the qualifying value.

metadata.doc_title: Food, Beverage and Dietary Supplements Category Guideline

text:
Food, Beverage and Dietary Supplements Category Guideline > 4. Claims > CAT-004-C10 Supplement Dosage Disclosure

Supplements shall state the serving size, servings per container, and the quantity of
each active ingredient per serving. Proprietary blends shall disclose total blend weight
and the ingredients in descending order.

metadata.doc_title: Food, Beverage and Dietary Supplements Category Guideline

text:
Cosmetics and Personal Care Category Guideline > 1. Scope and Approval > CAT-005-C1 Covered Products

This guideline covers skincare, colour cosmetics, haircare, oral care, fragrance,
deodorants, and personal hygiene products. Listing requires the cosmetics and personal
care category approval under CLS-006-C4.

metadata.doc_title: Cosmetics and Personal Care Category Guideline

text:
Cosmetics and Personal Care Category Guideline > 1. Scope and Approval > CAT-005-C2 Responsible Person Evidence

The approval application shall identify the responsible person or importer of record for
the storefront jurisdiction and shall provide the product information file reference.

metadata.doc_title: Cosmetics and Personal Care Category Guideline

text:
Cosmetics and Personal Care Category Guideline > 2. Mandatory Labelling > CAT-005-C3 Full Ingredient Listing

Every cosmetic listing shall publish the complete ingredient list using the
international nomenclature, in descending order of weight, with ingredients below one
percent permitted in any order after the one percent threshold. An incomplete or
paraphrased ingredient list is a Tier 1 labelling defect.

metadata.doc_title: Cosmetics and Personal Care Category Guideline

text:
Cosmetics and Personal Care Category Guideline > 2. Mandatory Labelling > CAT-005-C4 Period After Opening

Products with a durability greater than 30 months shall declare the period-after-opening
value in months. Products with a durability of 30 months or less shall declare a minimum
durability date. One of the two is mandatory; declaring neither is a Tier 1 defect.

metadata.doc_title: Cosmetics and Personal Care Category Guideline

text:
Cosmetics and Personal Care Category Guideline > 2. Mandatory Labelling > CAT-005-C5 Net Content and Batch

The listing shall declare net content by weight or volume and shall confirm that the
supplied unit carries a batch or lot code enabling traceability.

metadata.doc_title: Cosmetics and Personal Care Category Guideline

text:
Cosmetics and Personal Care Category Guideline > 2. Mandatory Labelling > CAT-005-C6 Warning Statements

Where the product requires a statutory warning — for example hair dyes requiring the
allergy alert and patch test statement, or aerosol products requiring flammability
warnings — the warning shall be reproduced verbatim in the listing bullet features and
shall be legible in the label image.

metadata.doc_title: Cosmetics and Personal Care Category Guideline

text:
Cosmetics and Personal Care Category Guideline > 3. Claims > CAT-005-C7 Cosmetic Versus Medicinal Boundary

A cosmetic may claim to cleanse, perfume, change appearance, protect, or keep in good
condition. Claims to treat, heal, or prevent a medical condition reclassify the product
as a medicine and are prohibited in this category.

metadata.doc_title: Cosmetics and Personal Care Category Guideline

text:
Cosmetics and Personal Care Category Guideline > 3. Claims > CAT-005-C8 Prohibited Claim Examples

The following are prohibited: "cures acne", "removes wrinkles permanently",
"anti-bacterial" without a biocidal authorisation, "SPF 100+", "reverses hair loss", and
"dermatologist prescribed".

metadata.doc_title: Cosmetics and Personal Care Category Guideline

text:
Cosmetics and Personal Care Category Guideline > 3. Claims > CAT-005-C9 Sun Protection Claims

Sun protection factor may be stated only in the permitted category bands, with the
highest permitted expression being "50+". A broad-spectrum claim requires a stated
ultraviolet-A protection ratio of at least one third of the labelled factor.

metadata.doc_title: Cosmetics and Personal Care Category Guideline

text:
Cosmetics and Personal Care Category Guideline > 3. Claims > CAT-005-C10 Restricted Cosmetic Ingredients

Ingredients restricted under RSR-002, including hydroquinone, mercury compounds, and
specified corticosteroids, are prohibited in cosmetics regardless of concentration
unless an explicit exemption is recorded in RSR-002.

metadata.doc_title: Cosmetics and Personal Care Category Guideline

text:
Home, Garden and Household Chemicals Category Guideline > 1. Scope and Approval > CAT-006-C1 Covered Products

This guideline covers cleaning products, detergents, adhesives, paints and coatings,
garden chemicals, pest control products, and air fresheners. Chemical and cleaning
products require the category approval under CLS-006-C4.

metadata.doc_title: Home, Garden and Household Chemicals Category Guideline

text:
Home, Garden and Household Chemicals Category Guideline > 1. Scope and Approval > CAT-006-C2 Safety Data Sheet Requirement

The approval application shall include a current safety data sheet for each chemical
product, dated within the preceding 24 months.

metadata.doc_title: Home, Garden and Household Chemicals Category Guideline

text:
Home, Garden and Household Chemicals Category Guideline > 2. Hazard Communication > CAT-006-C3 Hazard Pictograms

Products classified as hazardous shall display the applicable hazard pictograms, signal
word, hazard statements, and precautionary statements in the listing bullet features and
in a legible label image. Omitting any required hazard element is a Tier 1 safety
labelling defect.

metadata.doc_title: Home, Garden and Household Chemicals Category Guideline

text:
Home, Garden and Household Chemicals Category Guideline > 2. Hazard Communication > CAT-006-C4 Signal Word Accuracy

The signal word shall be the one assigned by the classification: "Danger" for the more
severe hazard categories and "Warning" for the less severe. Downgrading the signal word
is a Tier 1 defect.

metadata.doc_title: Home, Garden and Household Chemicals Category Guideline

text:
Home, Garden and Household Chemicals Category Guideline > 2. Hazard Communication > CAT-006-C5 Child-Resistant Closures

Products requiring a child-resistant closure under the storefront jurisdiction's rules
shall confirm the closure type in the attributes and shall not be repackaged into
non-compliant containers.

metadata.doc_title: Home, Garden and Household Chemicals Category Guideline

text:
Home, Garden and Household Chemicals Category Guideline > 2. Hazard Communication > CAT-006-C6 Tactile Danger Warning

Products requiring a tactile warning for the visually impaired shall confirm its
presence in the attributes.

metadata.doc_title: Home, Garden and Household Chemicals Category Guideline

text:
Home, Garden and Household Chemicals Category Guideline > 3. Specific Restrictions > CAT-006-C7 Biocidal Products

Products making a biocidal claim, including disinfectants and sanitisers, require a
product authorisation number stated in the listing. A biocidal claim without an
authorisation number is a Tier 1 defect.

metadata.doc_title: Home, Garden and Household Chemicals Category Guideline

text:
Home, Garden and Household Chemicals Category Guideline > 3. Specific Restrictions > CAT-006-C8 Pesticides and Garden Chemicals

Plant protection products may be listed only where authorised for amateur use in the
storefront jurisdiction, with the authorisation number stated.

metadata.doc_title: Home, Garden and Household Chemicals Category Guideline

text:
Home, Garden and Household Chemicals Category Guideline > 3. Specific Restrictions > CAT-006-C9 Aerosol Products

Aerosols shall declare propellant type, shall carry the pressurised container warning,
and shall be flagged as dangerous goods for fulfilment under CLS-004-C8.

metadata.doc_title: Home, Garden and Household Chemicals Category Guideline

text:
Home, Garden and Household Chemicals Category Guideline > 3. Specific Restrictions > CAT-006-C10 Concentration Limits

Where RSR-001 or RSR-004 sets a maximum concentration for a substance in a consumer
product, exceeding that concentration is prohibited even where the product is otherwise
correctly labelled.

metadata.doc_title: Home, Garden and Household Chemicals Category Guideline

text:
Product Title and Naming Standards > 1. Purpose and Scope > CLS-001-C1 Applicability

This standard governs the construction of the product title field for every listing
published to the marketplace catalog, in every category and every storefront locale.
Where a category guideline imposes a stricter title rule, the category guideline
prevails over this document.

metadata.doc_title: Product Title and Naming Standards

text:
Product Title and Naming Standards > 1. Purpose and Scope > CLS-001-C2 Definition of Title

The title is the single-line primary product name displayed in search results, on the
product detail page, and in the seller feed export. It is distinct from the short
description and the bullet feature list, which are governed by CLS-002.

metadata.doc_title: Product Title and Naming Standards

text:
Product Title and Naming Standards > 2. Mandatory Title Composition > CLS-001-C3 Required Title Elements

A compliant title shall contain, in order: brand, product line or model designation,
the distinguishing product type noun, and the primary variant attribute (such as size,
colour, or capacity). Omitting the brand element is a Tier 2 listing defect where a
brand exists for the product.

metadata.doc_title: Product Title and Naming Standards

text:
Product Title and Naming Standards > 2. Mandatory Title Composition > CLS-001-C4 Character Length Limits

Titles shall be between 20 and 200 characters inclusive. Titles under 20 characters are
rejected at submission. Titles between 150 and 200 characters generate a soft warning
in the seller dashboard because they truncate on mobile search surfaces.

metadata.doc_title: Product Title and Naming Standards

text:
Product Title and Naming Standards > 2. Mandatory Title Composition > CLS-001-C5 Capitalisation

Title case shall be used: the first letter of each principal word is capitalised.
Full-uppercase titles, except for genuine acronyms and registered trademarks that are
themselves uppercase, are a Tier 2 defect and are auto-corrected by the catalog
normaliser.

metadata.doc_title: Product Title and Naming Standards

text:
Product Title and Naming Standards > 3. Prohibited Title Content > CLS-001-C6 Promotional and Marketing Language

Titles shall not contain promotional claims, price references, shipping terms, or
urgency language. Prohibited examples include "free shipping", "best seller",
"sale now", "limited stock", "cheapest", and "100% guaranteed". Detection of
promotional language is a Tier 1 defect and suppresses the listing from search.

metadata.doc_title: Product Title and Naming Standards

text:
Product Title and Naming Standards > 3. Prohibited Title Content > CLS-001-C7 Seller Identity and Contact Details

Titles shall not include the seller's store name, website address, email address,
telephone number, or any off-platform contact instruction. This is a Tier 1 defect and
triggers immediate listing suppression pending seller correction.

metadata.doc_title: Product Title and Naming Standards

text:
Product Title and Naming Standards > 3. Prohibited Title Content > CLS-001-C8 Symbols and Decorative Characters

Titles shall not contain emoji, decorative unicode symbols, repeated punctuation, or
HTML markup. The characters permitted outside alphanumerics are hyphen, comma, period,
forward slash, ampersand, parenthesis, and the degree sign.

metadata.doc_title: Product Title and Naming Standards

text:
Product Title and Naming Standards > 3. Prohibited Title Content > CLS-001-C9 Keyword Stuffing

Repeating a term more than twice, or appending unrelated category keywords to widen
search reach, constitutes keyword stuffing. This is a Tier 1 defect. Repeat offences
within a rolling 90-day window escalate to a selling-privilege review.

metadata.doc_title: Product Title and Naming Standards

text:
Product Title and Naming Standards > 4. Remediation > CLS-001-C10 Correction Window

A seller notified of a Tier 2 title defect has 14 calendar days to correct the listing
before it is suppressed. Tier 1 defects are suppressed immediately and reinstated only
after the corrected title passes automated validation.

metadata.doc_title: Product Title and Naming Standards

text:
Product Description and Bullet Feature Standards > 1. Scope > CLS-002-C1 Fields Governed

This standard governs the long description field, the bullet feature list, and the
"what is in the box" field. Title construction is governed separately by CLS-001.

metadata.doc_title: Product Description and Bullet Feature Standards

text:
Product Description and Bullet Feature Standards > 2. Bullet Feature List > CLS-002-C2 Bullet Count and Length

A listing shall provide between three and seven bullet features. Each bullet shall be
between 30 and 255 characters. Listings with fewer than three bullets are ineligible
for featured placement and are flagged as an incomplete-content defect.

metadata.doc_title: Product Description and Bullet Feature Standards

text:
Product Description and Bullet Feature Standards > 2. Bullet Feature List > CLS-002-C3 Bullet Content Rules

Each bullet shall describe a factual, verifiable product attribute or use case. Bullets
shall not restate the title verbatim, shall not contain pricing or promotional terms,
and shall not include comparative claims against a named competitor product.

metadata.doc_title: Product Description and Bullet Feature Standards

text:
Product Description and Bullet Feature Standards > 2. Bullet Feature List > CLS-002-C4 Leading Attribute Convention

Each bullet should open with a two to four word capitalised attribute label followed by
a colon, for example "Water Resistance: rated IPX7 for 30 minutes at one metre". This
convention is recommended, not mandatory, and its absence is not a defect.

metadata.doc_title: Product Description and Bullet Feature Standards

text:
Product Description and Bullet Feature Standards > 3. Long Description > CLS-002-C5 Minimum Substantive Content

The long description shall contain at least 150 characters of substantive product
information. Descriptions consisting only of a repeated title, a keyword list, or a
generic brand statement do not satisfy this clause.

metadata.doc_title: Product Description and Bullet Feature Standards

text:
Product Description and Bullet Feature Standards > 3. Long Description > CLS-002-C6 Permitted Markup

Only the following HTML tags are permitted in the long description: paragraph, line
break, unordered list, list item, bold, and italic. Script tags, iframes, embedded
media, forms, and anchor tags of any kind are stripped by the sanitiser and their
presence is a Tier 1 defect.

metadata.doc_title: Product Description and Bullet Feature Standards

text:
Product Description and Bullet Feature Standards > 3. Long Description > CLS-002-C7 Off-Platform Diversion

The description shall not contain any instruction, link, QR code, or encoded reference
directing the buyer to complete a transaction outside the marketplace. This is a Tier 1
defect and a selling-policy violation independent of the catalog defect process.

metadata.doc_title: Product Description and Bullet Feature Standards

text:
Product Description and Bullet Feature Standards > 4. Claims Discipline > CLS-002-C8 Substantiation Requirement

Any performance, health, environmental, or safety claim made in the description shall be
substantiable on request within 10 business days. The marketplace may require test
reports, certification numbers, or a manufacturer declaration as substantiation.

metadata.doc_title: Product Description and Bullet Feature Standards

text:
Product Description and Bullet Feature Standards > 4. Claims Discipline > CLS-002-C9 Prohibited Absolute Claims

Unqualified absolute claims are prohibited in the description. Prohibited forms include
"cures", "prevents disease", "100% safe", "non-toxic" without a standard reference, and
"eco-friendly" without a named certification scheme.

metadata.doc_title: Product Description and Bullet Feature Standards

text:
Product Description and Bullet Feature Standards > 4. Claims Discipline > CLS-002-C10 Comparative Claims

Comparative claims are permitted only against the seller's own prior model, and only
when the comparison basis is stated in the same sentence.

metadata.doc_title: Product Description and Bullet Feature Standards

text:
Attribute Completeness and Variation Family Standards > 1. Attribute Completeness > CLS-003-C1 Mandatory Attribute Set

Every listing shall populate the category's mandatory attribute set in full. The
mandatory set always includes brand, manufacturer part number, country of origin,
package dimensions, package weight, and the category-specific attributes named in the
relevant category guideline.

metadata.doc_title: Attribute Completeness and Variation Family Standards

text:
Attribute Completeness and Variation Family Standards > 1. Attribute Completeness > CLS-003-C2 Attribute Completeness Score

Listings receive an attribute completeness score expressed as a percentage of the
recommended attribute set populated. A score below 70 percent makes the listing
ineligible for featured placement and for inclusion in the curated category browse.

metadata.doc_title: Attribute Completeness and Variation Family Standards

text:
Attribute Completeness and Variation Family Standards > 1. Attribute Completeness > CLS-003-C3 Prohibited Placeholder Values

Placeholder values are prohibited in any attribute field. Values such as "N/A", "NA",
"none", "TBD", "0", "-", "generic", and "unbranded" are rejected where the attribute is
mandatory. Where a product genuinely has no brand, the reserved value
"No Brand Declared" shall be used with a manufacturer name supplied.

metadata.doc_title: Attribute Completeness and Variation Family Standards

text:
Attribute Completeness and Variation Family Standards > 1. Attribute Completeness > CLS-003-C4 Unit Consistency

Numeric attributes shall be submitted with the unit of measure declared in the category
schema. Mixing imperial and metric units within one variation family is an attribute
defect and blocks variation grouping.

metadata.doc_title: Attribute Completeness and Variation Family Standards

text:
Attribute Completeness and Variation Family Standards > 2. Variation Families > CLS-003-C5 Valid Variation Axes

Products may be grouped into a variation family only along an approved axis: size,
colour, capacity, material, flavour, pack quantity, or fit. Grouping distinct products
along an unapproved axis to inherit a parent listing's review history is prohibited.

metadata.doc_title: Attribute Completeness and Variation Family Standards

text:
Attribute Completeness and Variation Family Standards > 2. Variation Families > CLS-003-C6 Review Manipulation Through Variations

Repurposing an existing variation family to sell a materially different product is a
Tier 1 defect, is treated as review manipulation, and results in removal of the
accumulated review history from the family.

metadata.doc_title: Attribute Completeness and Variation Family Standards

text:
Attribute Completeness and Variation Family Standards > 2. Variation Families > CLS-003-C7 Parent Listing Rules

The parent record in a variation family is not itself purchasable and shall not carry a
price or inventory quantity. The parent title shall omit the variant attribute that
distinguishes the children.

metadata.doc_title: Attribute Completeness and Variation Family Standards

text:
Attribute Completeness and Variation Family Standards > 2. Variation Families > CLS-003-C8 Child Listing Distinctness

Each child in a variation family shall differ from every sibling in at least one
approved variation axis value. Duplicate children with identical attribute values are
merged automatically and the surplus records are archived.

metadata.doc_title: Attribute Completeness and Variation Family Standards

text:
Attribute Completeness and Variation Family Standards > 3. Identifiers > CLS-003-C9 Product Identifier Requirement

A valid global trade item number is required for every listing except in categories
granted an identifier exemption. Submitted identifiers are validated against the check
digit and against the brand registry.

metadata.doc_title: Attribute Completeness and Variation Family Standards

text:
Attribute Completeness and Variation Family Standards > 3. Identifiers > CLS-003-C10 Identifier Reuse

Reusing an identifier previously assigned to a different product is prohibited and
results in immediate suppression of the offending listing.

metadata.doc_title: Attribute Completeness and Variation Family Standards

text:
Pricing, Availability and Fulfilment Data Standards > 1. Price Data > CLS-004-C1 Price Field Accuracy

The listed price shall be the total price payable for the item excluding shipping and
statutory taxes shown separately at checkout. Splitting an item's true price between the
item price and an inflated shipping charge is a Tier 1 defect.

metadata.doc_title: Pricing, Availability and Fulfilment Data Standards

text:
Pricing, Availability and Fulfilment Data Standards > 1. Price Data > CLS-004-C2 Reference Price Substantiation

A struck-through reference price may be displayed only where the item was offered at
that price on the marketplace for at least 28 of the preceding 90 days, or where the
price is the manufacturer's published recommended retail price.

metadata.doc_title: Pricing, Availability and Fulfilment Data Standards

text:
Pricing, Availability and Fulfilment Data Standards > 1. Price Data > CLS-004-C3 Currency and Locale

Prices shall be submitted in the storefront's settlement currency. Locale conversion is
performed by the platform; sellers shall not submit pre-converted prices.

metadata.doc_title: Pricing, Availability and Fulfilment Data Standards

text:
Pricing, Availability and Fulfilment Data Standards > 2. Availability > CLS-004-C4 Inventory Truthfulness

Declared inventory quantity shall reflect stock the seller can dispatch within the
stated handling time. Persistent cancellation due to unavailable stock is measured as
the pre-fulfilment cancellation rate and is capped at 2.5 percent per rolling 30 days.

metadata.doc_title: Pricing, Availability and Fulfilment Data Standards

text:
Pricing, Availability and Fulfilment Data Standards > 2. Availability > CLS-004-C5 Handling Time Declaration

Handling time shall be declared in whole business days and shall not exceed 10 business
days without a category exemption. Listings exceeding the cap without exemption are
suppressed from search.

metadata.doc_title: Pricing, Availability and Fulfilment Data Standards

text:
Pricing, Availability and Fulfilment Data Standards > 2. Availability > CLS-004-C6 Pre-Order and Backorder Listings

A pre-order listing shall declare an expected dispatch date and shall not be published
more than 120 days ahead of that date. The expected dispatch date is a mandatory
attribute for pre-order listings.

metadata.doc_title: Pricing, Availability and Fulfilment Data Standards

text:
Pricing, Availability and Fulfilment Data Standards > 3. Fulfilment Data > CLS-004-C7 Package Dimension Accuracy

Package dimensions and weight shall be the dispatch-ready measurements including
protective packaging. A variance beyond 10 percent from the measured value at the
fulfilment centre triggers a dimensional correction and a chargeback of the shipping
differential.

metadata.doc_title: Pricing, Availability and Fulfilment Data Standards

text:
Pricing, Availability and Fulfilment Data Standards > 3. Fulfilment Data > CLS-004-C8 Hazardous Goods Fulfilment Flag

Any item meeting the definition of dangerous goods in SAF-004 shall carry the hazardous
goods fulfilment flag with the applicable transport classification. Omitting this flag
is a Tier 1 defect regardless of whether the item is otherwise compliant.

metadata.doc_title: Pricing, Availability and Fulfilment Data Standards

text:
Pricing, Availability and Fulfilment Data Standards > 3. Fulfilment Data > CLS-004-C9 Country of Origin

Country of origin shall be the country of substantial transformation, not the country of
dispatch or the seller's registered country.

metadata.doc_title: Pricing, Availability and Fulfilment Data Standards

text:
Pricing, Availability and Fulfilment Data Standards > 3. Fulfilment Data > CLS-004-C10 Import Duty Disclosure

Where an item ships across a customs border, the listing shall indicate whether import
duties are prepaid or payable by the buyer on delivery.

metadata.doc_title: Pricing, Availability and Fulfilment Data Standards

text:
Listing Defect Taxonomy and Enforcement Ladder > 1. Defect Tiers > CLS-005-C1 Tier 1 Defects

A Tier 1 defect is one that misleads the buyer, evades platform controls, or creates a
safety or legal exposure. Tier 1 defects result in immediate listing suppression at
detection, without a correction window. Examples include prohibited safety claims,
off-platform diversion, missing hazard labelling, and identifier reuse.

metadata.doc_title: Listing Defect Taxonomy and Enforcement Ladder

text:
Listing Defect Taxonomy and Enforcement Ladder > 1. Defect Tiers > CLS-005-C2 Tier 2 Defects

A Tier 2 defect degrades catalog quality without misleading the buyer. Tier 2 defects
carry a 14 calendar day correction window before suppression. Examples include
capitalisation violations, missing brand element, and incomplete bullet lists.

metadata.doc_title: Listing Defect Taxonomy and Enforcement Ladder

text:
Listing Defect Taxonomy and Enforcement Ladder > 1. Defect Tiers > CLS-005-C3 Tier 3 Defects

A Tier 3 defect is advisory. It generates a dashboard recommendation, does not suppress
the listing, and does not count toward the enforcement ladder. Examples include a title
between 150 and 200 characters and a missing leading attribute label in bullets.

metadata.doc_title: Listing Defect Taxonomy and Enforcement Ladder

text:
Listing Defect Taxonomy and Enforcement Ladder > 2. Enforcement Ladder > CLS-005-C4 First Occurrence

A first Tier 1 or Tier 2 defect on a listing produces a notification to the seller
identifying the clause breached and the required correction.

metadata.doc_title: Listing Defect Taxonomy and Enforcement Ladder

text:
Listing Defect Taxonomy and Enforcement Ladder > 2. Enforcement Ladder > CLS-005-C5 Repeat Occurrence

Three or more Tier 1 defects across a seller's catalog within a rolling 90-day window
escalate to a selling-privilege review. The review considers the seller's overall
defect rate, correction responsiveness, and category risk profile.

metadata.doc_title: Listing Defect Taxonomy and Enforcement Ladder

text:
Listing Defect Taxonomy and Enforcement Ladder > 2. Enforcement Ladder > CLS-005-C6 Systemic Breach

A pattern of the same Tier 1 defect across more than 20 listings is treated as a
systemic breach and may result in category-level selling restriction pending a
remediation plan.

metadata.doc_title: Listing Defect Taxonomy and Enforcement Ladder

text:
Listing Defect Taxonomy and Enforcement Ladder > 3. Appeals > CLS-005-C7 Appeal Right

A seller may appeal any suppression within 30 calendar days. The appeal shall identify
the clause, state the basis of the challenge, and attach any substantiating evidence.

metadata.doc_title: Listing Defect Taxonomy and Enforcement Ladder

text:
Listing Defect Taxonomy and Enforcement Ladder > 3. Appeals > CLS-005-C8 Appeal Outcome Window

Appeals are decided within 10 business days. A listing under appeal remains suppressed
during the review except where the suppression was a Tier 2 defect corrected before the
appeal was filed.

metadata.doc_title: Listing Defect Taxonomy and Enforcement Ladder

text:
Listing Defect Taxonomy and Enforcement Ladder > 3. Appeals > CLS-005-C9 Automated Detection Disclosure

Where a defect was detected by an automated classifier, the seller is entitled on
request to know which clause the classifier evaluated. The classifier's internal score
is not disclosed.

metadata.doc_title: Listing Defect Taxonomy and Enforcement Ladder

text:
Listing Defect Taxonomy and Enforcement Ladder > 3. Appeals > CLS-005-C10 No Advisory Determination

Enforcement decisions record a catalog policy outcome only. They are not a legal
determination of the product's regulatory compliance in any jurisdiction, and sellers
remain responsible for their own regulatory obligations.

metadata.doc_title: Listing Defect Taxonomy and Enforcement Ladder

text:
Prohibited and Restricted Listing Categories > 1. Definitions > CLS-006-C1 Prohibited Versus Restricted

A prohibited item may not be listed under any circumstance. A restricted item may be
listed only by a seller holding the applicable category approval and only where every
condition attached to that approval is met.

metadata.doc_title: Prohibited and Restricted Listing Categories

text:
Prohibited and Restricted Listing Categories > 2. Prohibited Items > CLS-006-C2 Categorically Prohibited Goods

The following may not be listed: weapons and ammunition, explosive precursors,
counterfeit goods, recalled products, human remains or bodily fluids, stolen goods,
government identity documents, live animals, and any item whose supply is prohibited by
law in the storefront's jurisdiction.

metadata.doc_title: Prohibited and Restricted Listing Categories

text:
Prohibited and Restricted Listing Categories > 2. Prohibited Items > CLS-006-C3 Recalled Product Rule

A product subject to an active safety recall in the storefront jurisdiction is
prohibited from the moment the recall is published, regardless of the seller's stock
position or the recall's remediation status.

metadata.doc_title: Prohibited and Restricted Listing Categories

text:
Prohibited and Restricted Listing Categories > 3. Restricted Categories Requiring Approval > CLS-006-C4 Approval-Gated Categories

Category approval is required before listing in: dietary supplements, cosmetics and
personal care, children's toys and juvenile products, electrical goods with a mains
connection, laser products, battery-powered products containing lithium cells, and
chemical or cleaning products.

metadata.doc_title: Prohibited and Restricted Listing Categories

text:
Prohibited and Restricted Listing Categories > 3. Restricted Categories Requiring Approval > CLS-006-C5 Approval Evidence

An approval application shall provide the product's compliance documentation, a
supplier declaration of conformity where applicable, and images of the physical product
labelling as it will be supplied to the buyer.

metadata.doc_title: Prohibited and Restricted Listing Categories

text:
Prohibited and Restricted Listing Categories > 3. Restricted Categories Requiring Approval > CLS-006-C6 Approval Scope

Category approval is granted per seller per category, not per listing, and does not
transfer between marketplace accounts or across a change of legal entity.

metadata.doc_title: Prohibited and Restricted Listing Categories

text:
Prohibited and Restricted Listing Categories > 3. Restricted Categories Requiring Approval > CLS-006-C7 Approval Withdrawal

An approval may be withdrawn where the seller's category defect rate exceeds 5 percent
over a rolling 60-day window or where a Tier 1 safety defect is confirmed.

metadata.doc_title: Prohibited and Restricted Listing Categories

text:
Prohibited and Restricted Listing Categories > 4. Interaction With Other Policies > CLS-006-C8 Precedence

Where this document conflicts with a category guideline, the more restrictive provision
applies. Restricted-substance rules in the RSR series apply independently and are never
waived by a category approval.

metadata.doc_title: Prohibited and Restricted Listing Categories

text:
Prohibited and Restricted Listing Categories > 4. Interaction With Other Policies > CLS-006-C9 Grey Area Handling

Where it is unclear whether an item falls within a prohibited class, the seller shall
seek a written determination before listing. Listing first and seeking clarification
afterward is treated as an unapproved listing.

metadata.doc_title: Prohibited and Restricted Listing Categories

text:
Prohibited and Restricted Listing Categories > 4. Interaction With Other Policies > CLS-006-C10 No Legal Advice

Determinations under this document reflect marketplace policy only and do not
constitute legal advice on the lawfulness of supplying the item in any jurisdiction.

metadata.doc_title: Prohibited and Restricted Listing Categories

text:
Primary Product Image Standards > 1. Technical Requirements > IMG-001-C1 Minimum Resolution

The primary image shall be at least 1000 pixels on its longest side. Images below 1000
pixels do not support the zoom viewer and the listing is ineligible for featured
placement. Images below 500 pixels on the longest side are rejected at submission.

metadata.doc_title: Primary Product Image Standards

text:
Primary Product Image Standards > 1. Technical Requirements > IMG-001-C2 Accepted Formats and File Size

Accepted formats are JPEG, PNG, and WebP. The maximum file size is 10 megabytes. Animated
formats and progressive interlacing are not accepted for the primary image.

metadata.doc_title: Primary Product Image Standards

text:
Primary Product Image Standards > 1. Technical Requirements > IMG-001-C3 Aspect Ratio and Framing

The primary image shall be square or between 1:1 and 4:3. The product shall occupy at
least 85 percent of the image frame.

metadata.doc_title: Primary Product Image Standards

text:
Primary Product Image Standards > 2. Background and Composition > IMG-001-C4 Pure White Background

The primary image shall have a pure white background with RGB values 255, 255, 255.
Off-white, gradient, textured, and lifestyle backgrounds are not permitted for the
primary image. This is a Tier 2 defect.

metadata.doc_title: Primary Product Image Standards

text:
Primary Product Image Standards > 2. Background and Composition > IMG-001-C5 Single Product Depiction

The primary image shall depict only the product being sold, in the quantity being sold.
Props, accessories not included in the purchase, and alternative colourways are not
permitted in the primary image.

metadata.doc_title: Primary Product Image Standards

text:
Primary Product Image Standards > 2. Background and Composition > IMG-001-C6 Product Must Be Real

The primary image shall be a photograph or a photorealistic render of the actual product
supplied. Line drawings, sketches, placeholder graphics, and stock images of a similar
but different product are prohibited.

metadata.doc_title: Primary Product Image Standards

text:
Primary Product Image Standards > 3. Prohibited Overlays > IMG-001-C7 No Text or Graphic Overlays

The primary image shall not contain text, logos, watermarks, borders, badges, colour
blocks, price flashes, promotional banners, or seller branding. Text that appears
physically on the product or its packaging is permitted.

metadata.doc_title: Primary Product Image Standards

text:
Primary Product Image Standards > 3. Prohibited Overlays > IMG-001-C8 No Placeholder or Coming Soon

Images stating "image coming soon", "no image available", or similar are prohibited and
result in listing suppression.

metadata.doc_title: Primary Product Image Standards

text:
Primary Product Image Standards > 3. Prohibited Overlays > IMG-001-C9 Nudity and Offensive Content

Images shall not contain nudity, sexually suggestive posing, graphic violence, or
offensive symbols. This is a Tier 1 defect and results in immediate suppression.

metadata.doc_title: Primary Product Image Standards

text:
Primary Product Image Standards > 3. Prohibited Overlays > IMG-001-C10 Image Rights

The seller shall hold the rights to every image used. Using a competitor's or brand
owner's image without authorisation is an intellectual property violation independent of
the catalog defect process.

metadata.doc_title: Primary Product Image Standards

text:
Secondary Image, Video and Gallery Standards > 1. Gallery Composition > IMG-002-C1 Recommended Gallery Size

A listing should provide between four and nine images in total. Listings with fewer than
three images are flagged as incomplete content and are ineligible for featured
placement.

metadata.doc_title: Secondary Image, Video and Gallery Standards

text:
Secondary Image, Video and Gallery Standards > 1. Gallery Composition > IMG-002-C2 Permitted Secondary Content

Secondary images may show alternative angles, the product in use, scale references,
packaging, included accessories, dimension diagrams, size charts, and label close-ups.

metadata.doc_title: Secondary Image, Video and Gallery Standards

text:
Secondary Image, Video and Gallery Standards > 1. Gallery Composition > IMG-002-C3 Lifestyle Images

Lifestyle images are permitted as secondary images and may include contextual props,
provided a caption or on-image note identifies any prop not included in the purchase.

metadata.doc_title: Secondary Image, Video and Gallery Standards

text:
Secondary Image, Video and Gallery Standards > 1. Gallery Composition > IMG-002-C4 Text Overlays Permitted

Informational text overlays are permitted on secondary images. Overlay text shall be
factual, shall not state price or promotional terms, and shall not obscure the product.

metadata.doc_title: Secondary Image, Video and Gallery Standards

text:
Secondary Image, Video and Gallery Standards > 2. Compliance Imagery > IMG-002-C5 Mandatory Label Images

Where a document in the SAF or RSR series requires a warning, ingredient panel, energy
label, or hazard pictogram to be shown, that label shall be reproduced as a legible
secondary image. The image shall be sharp enough that the mandatory text is readable at
100 percent zoom.

metadata.doc_title: Secondary Image, Video and Gallery Standards

text:
Secondary Image, Video and Gallery Standards > 2. Compliance Imagery > IMG-002-C6 Label Image Integrity

Label images shall be unretouched photographs of the actual supplied label. Recreating a
label as a graphic, or editing a label image to alter, add, or remove information, is a
Tier 1 defect.

metadata.doc_title: Secondary Image, Video and Gallery Standards

text:
Secondary Image, Video and Gallery Standards > 3. Video > IMG-002-C7 Video Requirements

Product videos shall be between 10 and 180 seconds, shall have a resolution of at least
720 pixels vertical, and shall not contain price references, promotional urgency, or
off-platform contact details.

metadata.doc_title: Secondary Image, Video and Gallery Standards

text:
Secondary Image, Video and Gallery Standards > 3. Video > IMG-002-C8 Video Claims Parity

Any claim made in a video is subject to the same substantiation requirement as a written
claim under CLS-002-C8, and prohibited claims under CLS-002-C9 are equally prohibited in
video.

metadata.doc_title: Secondary Image, Video and Gallery Standards

text:
Secondary Image, Video and Gallery Standards > 3. Video > IMG-002-C9 Accessibility

Videos containing spoken narration essential to understanding the product should provide
captions. This is a recommendation and its absence is a Tier 3 advisory only.

metadata.doc_title: Secondary Image, Video and Gallery Standards

text:
Secondary Image, Video and Gallery Standards > 3. Video > IMG-002-C10 Third-Party Content

User-generated or influencer content used in the gallery requires documented permission
and shall not present a personal testimonial as a substantiated product claim.

metadata.doc_title: Secondary Image, Video and Gallery Standards

text:
Image Authenticity, Manipulation and Generative Content Rules > 1. Permitted Editing > IMG-003-C1 Acceptable Adjustments

Permitted editing is limited to background removal or replacement with pure white,
cropping, straightening, exposure and white-balance correction, dust and sensor-spot
removal, and resizing. These adjustments shall not change the product's apparent colour,
finish, dimensions, or included contents.

metadata.doc_title: Image Authenticity, Manipulation and Generative Content Rules

text:
Image Authenticity, Manipulation and Generative Content Rules > 1. Permitted Editing > IMG-003-C2 Colour Fidelity

The edited image shall represent the product's true colour under neutral daylight.
Saturation or hue shifts that make the product appear a different colour than supplied
are a Tier 1 defect because they mislead the buyer.

metadata.doc_title: Image Authenticity, Manipulation and Generative Content Rules

text:
Image Authenticity, Manipulation and Generative Content Rules > 2. Prohibited Manipulation > IMG-003-C3 Content-Altering Edits

Adding, removing, or resizing product features, components, or included accessories in an
image is prohibited. Compositing a product into an image where it was never photographed
is prohibited unless disclosed as a render under IMG-003-C5.

metadata.doc_title: Image Authenticity, Manipulation and Generative Content Rules

text:
Image Authenticity, Manipulation and Generative Content Rules > 2. Prohibited Manipulation > IMG-003-C4 Misrepresenting Scale

Images shall not misrepresent the product's size. Where scale could be misjudged, a scale
reference such as a ruler or a common object shall be included as a secondary image with
the dimensions stated.

metadata.doc_title: Image Authenticity, Manipulation and Generative Content Rules

text:
Image Authenticity, Manipulation and Generative Content Rules > 3. Renders and Generative Content > IMG-003-C5 Photorealistic Render Disclosure

A computer-generated render may serve as the primary image only where it is
photorealistic, dimensionally accurate, and the listing states in an attribute that the
image is a render.

metadata.doc_title: Image Authenticity, Manipulation and Generative Content Rules

text:
Image Authenticity, Manipulation and Generative Content Rules > 3. Renders and Generative Content > IMG-003-C6 Generative AI Imagery

Images produced by a generative model may be used only as secondary lifestyle images,
shall be labelled as illustrative in an on-image caption, and shall never be used as the
primary image or as a compliance label image under IMG-002-C5.

metadata.doc_title: Image Authenticity, Manipulation and Generative Content Rules

text:
Image Authenticity, Manipulation and Generative Content Rules > 3. Renders and Generative Content > IMG-003-C7 Prohibited Generative Uses

Generative imagery shall not be used to depict the product itself, to depict test
results, to depict certification marks, or to depict people in a way implying endorsement.

metadata.doc_title: Image Authenticity, Manipulation and Generative Content Rules

text:
Image Authenticity, Manipulation and Generative Content Rules > 4. Enforcement > IMG-003-C8 Detection and Review

Suspected manipulation is reviewed against the seller's supplied unedited source file.
Failure to produce the source file within 10 business days sustains the defect.

metadata.doc_title: Image Authenticity, Manipulation and Generative Content Rules

text:
Image Authenticity, Manipulation and Generative Content Rules > 4. Enforcement > IMG-003-C9 Repeat Manipulation

Two or more confirmed content-altering manipulations within a rolling 90-day window
escalate to a selling-privilege review under CLS-005-C5.

metadata.doc_title: Image Authenticity, Manipulation and Generative Content Rules

text:
Image Authenticity, Manipulation and Generative Content Rules > 4. Enforcement > IMG-003-C10 Buyer Remedy Independence

Enforcement under this document does not affect a buyer's separate remedy for an item
not as described.

metadata.doc_title: Image Authenticity, Manipulation and Generative Content Rules

text:
Category-Specific Image Requirements > 1. Apparel and Footwear > IMG-004-C1 Model and Flat-Lay Rules

Apparel may be shown on a model or as a flat lay. Where a model is used, the model's
height and the garment size worn shall be stated in the image caption or the bullet
features. Mannequins shall be either fully invisible or a neutral, unbranded form.

metadata.doc_title: Category-Specific Image Requirements

text:
Category-Specific Image Requirements > 1. Apparel and Footwear > IMG-004-C2 Mandatory Apparel Images

Apparel listings shall include a front view, a back view, a fabric close-up, and the
size chart image required by CAT-002-C4.

metadata.doc_title: Category-Specific Image Requirements

text:
Category-Specific Image Requirements > 2. Food, Supplements and Cosmetics > IMG-004-C3 Ingredient and Nutrition Panel Image

Food, supplement, and cosmetic listings shall include a sharp, legible, unretouched image
of the physical ingredient list and, for food, the nutrition panel. This image is
mandatory and its absence causes suppression under CAT-004-C5 and CAT-005-C3.

metadata.doc_title: Category-Specific Image Requirements

text:
Category-Specific Image Requirements > 2. Food, Supplements and Cosmetics > IMG-004-C4 Serving Depiction

Where a serving suggestion is depicted, the image shall carry an on-image caption stating
"serving suggestion" and shall not include ingredients not supplied with the product.

metadata.doc_title: Category-Specific Image Requirements

text:
Category-Specific Image Requirements > 3. Toys and Juvenile Products > IMG-004-C5 Warning Label Image

Toys carrying a choking, magnet, or button cell warning shall include a legible image of
the packaging face bearing that warning, per SAF-002-C4 and SAF-003-C7.

metadata.doc_title: Category-Specific Image Requirements

text:
Category-Specific Image Requirements > 3. Toys and Juvenile Products > IMG-004-C6 Depiction of Use

Images shall depict age-appropriate use consistent with CAT-003-C10, with any required
supervision visible or noted in the caption.

metadata.doc_title: Category-Specific Image Requirements

text:
Category-Specific Image Requirements > 4. Electronics and Chemicals > IMG-004-C7 Port, Plug and Rating Plate

Electronics listings shall include an image of the supplied plug and, where present, the
rating plate showing input voltage, so buyers can verify compatibility under CAT-001-C6.

metadata.doc_title: Category-Specific Image Requirements

text:
Category-Specific Image Requirements > 4. Electronics and Chemicals > IMG-004-C8 Hazard Pictogram Image

Chemical products shall include an image of the label face bearing the hazard pictograms,
signal word, and precautionary statements required by CAT-006-C3.

metadata.doc_title: Category-Specific Image Requirements

text:
Category-Specific Image Requirements > 4. Electronics and Chemicals > IMG-004-C9 Energy Label Image

Products subject to an energy label under CAT-001-C7 shall include the energy label as a
secondary image in its prescribed graphical form, unaltered.

metadata.doc_title: Category-Specific Image Requirements

text:
Category-Specific Image Requirements > 4. Electronics and Chemicals > IMG-004-C10 Precedence

Where this document and a category guideline both specify an image requirement, both
apply cumulatively; neither waives the other.

metadata.doc_title: Category-Specific Image Requirements

text:
Content Moderation and Prohibited Imagery > 1. Prohibited Imagery > IMG-005-C1 Categorically Prohibited Content

Images shall not depict: sexual content involving minors, non-consensual sexual content,
graphic violence or injury, animal cruelty, self-harm, terrorist or extremist symbols,
or hate symbols. Detection results in immediate suppression and account escalation.

metadata.doc_title: Content Moderation and Prohibited Imagery

text:
Content Moderation and Prohibited Imagery > 1. Prohibited Imagery > IMG-005-C2 Adult Products

Where a product is lawfully sold in an adult category, imagery shall be limited to the
product itself on a plain background, without human models, and the listing shall carry
the adult content flag.

metadata.doc_title: Content Moderation and Prohibited Imagery

text:
Content Moderation and Prohibited Imagery > 1. Prohibited Imagery > IMG-005-C3 Weapons Imagery

Images depicting a weapon aimed at a person, or a weapon in a threatening context, are
prohibited even where the underlying product is a permitted item such as a costume prop
or a sporting item.

metadata.doc_title: Content Moderation and Prohibited Imagery

text:
Content Moderation and Prohibited Imagery > 2. People in Imagery > IMG-005-C4 Consent and Likeness

A recognisable person shall appear only with a documented model release. Using an image
of a public figure to imply endorsement is prohibited.

metadata.doc_title: Content Moderation and Prohibited Imagery

text:
Content Moderation and Prohibited Imagery > 2. People in Imagery > IMG-005-C5 Children in Imagery

Children may appear only where the product is intended for children, only in fully
clothed and non-suggestive depictions, and only with documented guardian consent.

metadata.doc_title: Content Moderation and Prohibited Imagery

text:
Content Moderation and Prohibited Imagery > 2. People in Imagery > IMG-005-C6 Medical and Body Imagery

Before-and-after imagery is prohibited for cosmetics and supplements because it
constitutes an unsubstantiated efficacy claim under CAT-005-C7 and CAT-004-C8.

metadata.doc_title: Content Moderation and Prohibited Imagery

text:
Content Moderation and Prohibited Imagery > 3. Certification and Trust Marks > IMG-005-C7 Certification Mark Accuracy

A certification or conformity mark may appear in imagery only where the product actually
holds that certification and the certificate reference is recorded in the compliance
attributes.

metadata.doc_title: Content Moderation and Prohibited Imagery

text:
Content Moderation and Prohibited Imagery > 3. Certification and Trust Marks > IMG-005-C8 Fabricated Trust Badges

Self-created badges resembling official marks, such as invented "approved" or "certified"
seals, are prohibited and are treated as a misleading claim.

metadata.doc_title: Content Moderation and Prohibited Imagery

text:
Content Moderation and Prohibited Imagery > 3. Certification and Trust Marks > IMG-005-C9 Award and Rating Claims

Imagery asserting an award, star rating, or ranking shall name the awarding body and the
year, and shall be substantiable under CLS-002-C8.

metadata.doc_title: Content Moderation and Prohibited Imagery

text:
Content Moderation and Prohibited Imagery > 3. Certification and Trust Marks > IMG-005-C10 Reporting and Appeal

Suppression under this document may be appealed under CLS-005-C7, except for content
prohibited under IMG-005-C1, which is not appealable.

metadata.doc_title: Content Moderation and Prohibited Imagery

text:
Accessibility and Alternative Text Guideline > 1. Alternative Text > IMG-006-C1 Alt Text Expectation

Every gallery image should carry alternative text describing what the image conveys.
Absence of alt text is a Tier 3 advisory defect and does not suppress the listing.

metadata.doc_title: Accessibility and Alternative Text Guideline

text:
Accessibility and Alternative Text Guideline > 1. Alternative Text > IMG-006-C2 Alt Text Content

Alt text shall describe the visual content factually in no more than 125 characters. It
shall not repeat the title verbatim, shall not contain keywords unrelated to the image,
and shall not contain promotional language.

metadata.doc_title: Accessibility and Alternative Text Guideline

text:
Accessibility and Alternative Text Guideline > 1. Alternative Text > IMG-006-C3 Compliance Image Alt Text

For a mandatory compliance label image under IMG-002-C5, the alt text shall transcribe
the warning text so it is available to assistive technology. This is a mandatory
requirement, not an advisory one, and its absence is a Tier 2 defect.

metadata.doc_title: Accessibility and Alternative Text Guideline

text:
Accessibility and Alternative Text Guideline > 2. Legibility for Low Vision > IMG-006-C4 Overlay Text Contrast

Text overlaid on secondary images shall meet a contrast ratio of at least 4.5 to 1
against its background.

metadata.doc_title: Accessibility and Alternative Text Guideline

text:
Accessibility and Alternative Text Guideline > 2. Legibility for Low Vision > IMG-006-C5 Minimum Overlay Text Size

Overlay text shall be rendered at no less than 3 percent of the image's longest side so
it remains legible on mobile surfaces.

metadata.doc_title: Accessibility and Alternative Text Guideline

text:
Accessibility and Alternative Text Guideline > 2. Legibility for Low Vision > IMG-006-C6 Colour as Sole Indicator

Colour shall not be the only means of conveying information in a diagram; a label, a
pattern, or a shape shall accompany it.

metadata.doc_title: Accessibility and Alternative Text Guideline

text:
Accessibility and Alternative Text Guideline > 3. Structured Content > IMG-006-C7 Machine-Readable Attributes Preferred

Information required for a purchase decision — dimensions, materials, compatibility —
shall be provided in structured attribute fields and not exclusively inside an image,
because image-only information is inaccessible to assistive technology and to search.

metadata.doc_title: Accessibility and Alternative Text Guideline

text:
Accessibility and Alternative Text Guideline > 3. Structured Content > IMG-006-C8 Size Chart Duplication

The size chart required by CAT-002-C4 shall additionally be provided as structured
attribute data where the category schema supports it.

metadata.doc_title: Accessibility and Alternative Text Guideline

text:
Accessibility and Alternative Text Guideline > 3. Structured Content > IMG-006-C9 Video Captions

Captions on product video are recommended under IMG-002-C9. Where the video is the sole
source of an assembly or safety instruction, captions are mandatory.

metadata.doc_title: Accessibility and Alternative Text Guideline

text:
Accessibility and Alternative Text Guideline > 3. Structured Content > IMG-006-C10 Review Cadence

This guideline is reviewed annually and requirements may move from advisory to mandatory
with 90 days notice to sellers.

metadata.doc_title: Accessibility and Alternative Text Guideline

text:
Restricted Substances Framework and General Limits > 1. Framework > RSR-001-C1 Purpose

This framework establishes the substances restricted or prohibited in products sold
through the marketplace, the concentration limits that apply, and the evidence a seller
shall hold.

metadata.doc_title: Restricted Substances Framework and General Limits

text:
Restricted Substances Framework and General Limits > 1. Framework > RSR-001-C2 Precedence Over Category Approval

A restricted-substance limit applies independently of any category approval. Holding a
category approval never waives a limit in the RSR series, per CLS-006-C8.

metadata.doc_title: Restricted Substances Framework and General Limits

text:
Restricted Substances Framework and General Limits > 1. Framework > RSR-001-C3 Concentration Basis

Unless a clause states otherwise, a concentration limit is expressed as a weight
percentage of the homogeneous material, not of the finished article.

metadata.doc_title: Restricted Substances Framework and General Limits

text:
Restricted Substances Framework and General Limits > 2. General Limits > RSR-001-C4 Heavy Metals in Consumer Articles

Lead shall not exceed 0.009 percent by weight in any accessible material of a product
intended for children. Cadmium shall not exceed 0.01 percent in plastic materials.
Mercury is prohibited in consumer articles other than as specified in a lighting or
measuring device exemption.

metadata.doc_title: Restricted Substances Framework and General Limits

text:
Restricted Substances Framework and General Limits > 2. General Limits > RSR-001-C5 Phthalates

The sum of the restricted phthalates DEHP, DBP, and BBP shall not exceed 0.1 percent by
weight in any plasticised material. In toys and childcare articles that can be placed in
the mouth, DINP, DIDP, and DNOP are additionally restricted to the same limit.

metadata.doc_title: Restricted Substances Framework and General Limits

text:
Restricted Substances Framework and General Limits > 2. General Limits > RSR-001-C6 Nickel Release

Articles in prolonged contact with skin shall not release more than 0.5 micrograms of
nickel per square centimetre per week. For items inserted into pierced body parts the
limit is 0.2 micrograms per square centimetre per week.

metadata.doc_title: Restricted Substances Framework and General Limits

text:
Restricted Substances Framework and General Limits > 2. General Limits > RSR-001-C7 Formaldehyde

Free formaldehyde in textiles in direct skin contact shall not exceed 75 milligrams per
kilogram, and 30 milligrams per kilogram for articles intended for children under 36
months.

metadata.doc_title: Restricted Substances Framework and General Limits

text:
Restricted Substances Framework and General Limits > 3. Evidence > RSR-001-C8 Test Report Requirement

The seller shall hold a test report from an accredited laboratory demonstrating
compliance with every limit applicable to the product, issued within the preceding 36
months or since the last material change, whichever is more recent.

metadata.doc_title: Restricted Substances Framework and General Limits

text:
Restricted Substances Framework and General Limits > 3. Evidence > RSR-001-C9 Production of Evidence

Test reports shall be produced within 10 business days of a marketplace request. Failure
to produce evidence sustains a non-compliance finding and suppresses the listing.

metadata.doc_title: Restricted Substances Framework and General Limits

text:
Restricted Substances Framework and General Limits > 3. Evidence > RSR-001-C10 Supplier Declarations

A supplier declaration of conformity is accepted as supporting evidence but does not
substitute for a test report where a clause expressly requires one.

metadata.doc_title: Restricted Substances Framework and General Limits

text:
Restricted and Prohibited Substances in Cosmetics > 1. Prohibited Substances > RSR-002-C1 Absolute Prohibitions

The following are prohibited in cosmetics at any concentration: mercury and its
compounds, hydroquinone in skin-lightening products, corticosteroids, tretinoin,
chloroform, and lead acetate. Detection is a Tier 1 defect with immediate suppression and
mandatory incident reporting under SAF-001-C10.

metadata.doc_title: Restricted and Prohibited Substances in Cosmetics

text:
Restricted and Prohibited Substances in Cosmetics > 1. Prohibited Substances > RSR-002-C2 Skin-Lightening Products

Skin-lightening products are a high-risk sub-category. Every listing requires a test
report under RSR-001-C8 covering mercury, hydroquinone, and corticosteroids before
approval is granted.

metadata.doc_title: Restricted and Prohibited Substances in Cosmetics

text:
Restricted and Prohibited Substances in Cosmetics > 2. Concentration-Limited Substances > RSR-002-C3 Preservatives

Methylisothiazolinone is limited to 0.0015 percent in rinse-off products and is
prohibited in leave-on products. Formaldehyde-releasing preservatives are limited to
0.2 percent expressed as free formaldehyde, and a product exceeding 0.05 percent shall
carry the statement "contains formaldehyde".

metadata.doc_title: Restricted and Prohibited Substances in Cosmetics

text:
Restricted and Prohibited Substances in Cosmetics > 2. Concentration-Limited Substances > RSR-002-C4 Hydrogen Peroxide

Hydrogen peroxide, present or released, is limited to 0.1 percent in oral products,
4 percent in hair products, and 2 percent in nail hardeners. Tooth whitening products
between 0.1 and 6 percent may be supplied only to dental practitioners.

metadata.doc_title: Restricted and Prohibited Substances in Cosmetics

text:
Restricted and Prohibited Substances in Cosmetics > 2. Concentration-Limited Substances > RSR-002-C5 Alpha Hydroxy Acids

Free acid concentration is limited to 10 percent for leave-on products with a pH not
below 3.5. Products above this limit are professional-use only and may not be listed for
consumer sale.

metadata.doc_title: Restricted and Prohibited Substances in Cosmetics

text:
Restricted and Prohibited Substances in Cosmetics > 2. Concentration-Limited Substances > RSR-002-C6 Salicylic Acid

Salicylic acid is limited to 3 percent in rinse-off hair products and 2 percent in other
products, and is prohibited in products for children under 3 years except in shampoos.

metadata.doc_title: Restricted and Prohibited Substances in Cosmetics

text:
Restricted and Prohibited Substances in Cosmetics > 3. Allergens and Labelling > RSR-002-C7 Fragrance Allergen Declaration

The 26 designated fragrance allergens shall be named individually in the ingredient list
where present above 0.001 percent in leave-on products or 0.01 percent in rinse-off
products.

metadata.doc_title: Restricted and Prohibited Substances in Cosmetics

text:
Restricted and Prohibited Substances in Cosmetics > 3. Allergens and Labelling > RSR-002-C8 Hair Dye Warnings

Oxidative hair dyes shall carry the allergy alert statement, the instruction not to use
on under-16s, the instruction not to use if the user has previously experienced a
reaction to a hair colourant, and the 48-hour allergy alert test instruction. All four
statements are mandatory in the listing under CAT-005-C6.

metadata.doc_title: Restricted and Prohibited Substances in Cosmetics

text:
Restricted and Prohibited Substances in Cosmetics > 3. Allergens and Labelling > RSR-002-C9 Nanomaterials

Ingredients present in nanoform shall be identified in the ingredient list with the
suffix "(nano)".

metadata.doc_title: Restricted and Prohibited Substances in Cosmetics

text:
Restricted and Prohibited Substances in Cosmetics > 3. Allergens and Labelling > RSR-002-C10 Animal Testing

Products tested on animals for cosmetic purposes after the storefront jurisdiction's
cut-off date may not be listed, and any cruelty-free claim requires a named certification
scheme under CLS-002-C9.

metadata.doc_title: Restricted and Prohibited Substances in Cosmetics

text:
Restricted Substances in Textiles, Leather and Footwear > 1. Dyes and Colourants > RSR-003-C1 Azo Dyes

Azo dyes that may release any of the 22 restricted aromatic amines shall not be used.
The limit is 30 milligrams per kilogram for each amine in the finished article.

metadata.doc_title: Restricted Substances in Textiles, Leather and Footwear

text:
Restricted Substances in Textiles, Leather and Footwear > 1. Dyes and Colourants > RSR-003-C2 Prohibited Individual Dyes

Disperse Blue 1, Disperse Orange 11, Disperse Yellow 3, and Navy Blue colourant as
specified in the restriction register are prohibited in textiles in skin contact.

metadata.doc_title: Restricted Substances in Textiles, Leather and Footwear

text:
Restricted Substances in Textiles, Leather and Footwear > 1. Dyes and Colourants > RSR-003-C3 Carcinogenic, Mutagenic and Reprotoxic Substances

Substances classified as carcinogenic, mutagenic, or toxic for reproduction category 1A
or 1B are restricted in textile articles in skin contact at the individual limits set in
the restriction register.

metadata.doc_title: Restricted Substances in Textiles, Leather and Footwear

text:
Restricted Substances in Textiles, Leather and Footwear > 2. Finishing Chemicals > RSR-003-C4 Perfluorinated Compounds

PFOA, PFOS, and their salts and precursors are restricted to 25 parts per billion for
PFOA and 1000 parts per billion for the sum of PFOA-related substances in water-repellent
finishes.

metadata.doc_title: Restricted Substances in Textiles, Leather and Footwear

text:
Restricted Substances in Textiles, Leather and Footwear > 2. Finishing Chemicals > RSR-003-C5 Chromium VI in Leather

Chromium VI shall not exceed 3 milligrams per kilogram in leather articles in contact
with the skin. This limit applies to footwear linings, straps, and leather garments.

metadata.doc_title: Restricted Substances in Textiles, Leather and Footwear

text:
Restricted Substances in Textiles, Leather and Footwear > 2. Finishing Chemicals > RSR-003-C6 Dimethylfumarate

Dimethylfumarate, used as an anti-mould agent in sachets, is prohibited above 0.1
milligrams per kilogram in the article or any part of it.

metadata.doc_title: Restricted Substances in Textiles, Leather and Footwear

text:
Restricted Substances in Textiles, Leather and Footwear > 2. Finishing Chemicals > RSR-003-C7 Nonylphenol Ethoxylates

Nonylphenol and nonylphenol ethoxylates shall not be present at or above 0.01 percent by
weight in textile articles that can be washed in water.
