metadata.doc_title: Restricted Substances in Textiles, Leather and Footwear

text:
Restricted Substances in Textiles, Leather and Footwear > 3. Metals and Components > RSR-003-C8 Nickel in Fasteners

Zips, studs, buttons, and buckles in prolonged skin contact are subject to the nickel
release limit in RSR-001-C6. This applies to jewellery-style accessories in the apparel
category.

metadata.doc_title: Restricted Substances in Textiles, Leather and Footwear

text:
Restricted Substances in Textiles, Leather and Footwear > 3. Metals and Components > RSR-003-C9 Lead and Cadmium in Trims

Lead and cadmium in metal trims, appliques, and jewellery components are subject to the
limits in RSR-001-C4.

metadata.doc_title: Restricted Substances in Textiles, Leather and Footwear

text:
Restricted Substances in Textiles, Leather and Footwear > 3. Metals and Components > RSR-003-C10 Testing Frequency

Textile test reports shall be renewed on any change of dye house, finishing chemical, or
component supplier, regardless of the 36-month window in RSR-001-C8.

metadata.doc_title: Restricted Substances in Textiles, Leather and Footwear

text:
Restricted Substances in Electrical and Electronic Equipment > 1. Hazardous Substance Limits > RSR-004-C1 Restricted Substances and Maximum Concentrations

In homogeneous materials of electrical and electronic equipment the following maximum
concentration values by weight apply: lead 0.1 percent, mercury 0.1 percent, cadmium
0.01 percent, hexavalent chromium 0.1 percent, polybrominated biphenyls 0.1 percent,
polybrominated diphenyl ethers 0.1 percent, and each of DEHP, BBP, DBP, and DIBP 0.1
percent.

metadata.doc_title: Restricted Substances in Electrical and Electronic Equipment

text:
Restricted Substances in Electrical and Electronic Equipment > 1. Hazardous Substance Limits > RSR-004-C2 Homogeneous Material Basis

Compliance is assessed per homogeneous material, meaning a material that cannot be
mechanically disjointed into different materials. Averaging across the whole product is
not permitted.

metadata.doc_title: Restricted Substances in Electrical and Electronic Equipment

text:
Restricted Substances in Electrical and Electronic Equipment > 1. Hazardous Substance Limits > RSR-004-C3 Exemptions

Where an exemption applies to a specific application, the exemption reference shall be
recorded in the compliance attributes. An unrecorded exemption is treated as
non-compliance.

metadata.doc_title: Restricted Substances in Electrical and Electronic Equipment

text:
Restricted Substances in Electrical and Electronic Equipment > 2. Documentation > RSR-004-C4 Technical Documentation

The seller shall hold or be able to obtain the technical documentation and the
declaration of conformity referencing the hazardous substance restriction, and shall
produce it within 10 business days under RSR-001-C9.

metadata.doc_title: Restricted Substances in Electrical and Electronic Equipment

text:
Restricted Substances in Electrical and Electronic Equipment > 2. Documentation > RSR-004-C5 Conformity Marking

The product shall bear the applicable conformity marking. Applying a marking without
holding the supporting documentation is a Tier 1 defect and a misleading claim.

metadata.doc_title: Restricted Substances in Electrical and Electronic Equipment

text:
Restricted Substances in Electrical and Electronic Equipment > 3. Batteries and Packaging > RSR-004-C6 Battery Substance Limits

Batteries shall not contain more than 0.0005 percent mercury by weight, and portable
batteries shall not contain more than 0.002 percent cadmium by weight, subject to the
recorded exemptions.

metadata.doc_title: Restricted Substances in Electrical and Electronic Equipment

text:
Restricted Substances in Electrical and Electronic Equipment > 3. Batteries and Packaging > RSR-004-C7 Battery Marking

Batteries and battery-containing products shall bear the crossed-out wheeled bin symbol
and, where limits are approached, the chemical symbol for the metal concerned.

metadata.doc_title: Restricted Substances in Electrical and Electronic Equipment

text:
Restricted Substances in Electrical and Electronic Equipment > 3. Batteries and Packaging > RSR-004-C8 Packaging Heavy Metals

The sum of lead, cadmium, mercury, and hexavalent chromium in packaging shall not exceed
100 parts per million by weight.

metadata.doc_title: Restricted Substances in Electrical and Electronic Equipment

text:
Restricted Substances in Electrical and Electronic Equipment > 4. Recycling Information > RSR-004-C9 Waste Electrical Marking

Electrical products shall bear the crossed-out wheeled bin symbol and the listing shall
state that the product must not be disposed of as unsorted household waste.

metadata.doc_title: Restricted Substances in Electrical and Electronic Equipment

text:
Restricted Substances in Electrical and Electronic Equipment > 4. Recycling Information > RSR-004-C10 Producer Registration

Where the storefront jurisdiction requires producer registration for electrical
equipment or batteries, the registration number shall be recorded in the compliance
attributes.

metadata.doc_title: Restricted Substances in Electrical and Electronic Equipment

text:
Restricted Substances in Food-Contact Materials and Toys > 1. Food-Contact Materials > RSR-005-C1 General Inertness Requirement

Materials intended to come into contact with food shall not transfer constituents to
food in quantities that endanger health, change the composition unacceptably, or
deteriorate the taste or odour.

metadata.doc_title: Restricted Substances in Food-Contact Materials and Toys
metadata.category: Food Contact, Toys and Juvenile Products

text:
Restricted Substances in Food-Contact Materials and Toys > 1. Food-Contact Materials > RSR-005-C2 Overall Migration Limit

The overall migration limit is 10 milligrams per square decimetre of contact surface, or
60 milligrams per kilogram of food for articles intended for infants and young children.

metadata.doc_title: Restricted Substances in Food-Contact Materials and Toys
metadata.category: Food Contact, Toys and Juvenile Products

text:
Restricted Substances in Food-Contact Materials and Toys > 1. Food-Contact Materials > RSR-005-C3 Bisphenol A

Bisphenol A is prohibited in infant feeding bottles, sippy cups, and any food-contact
article intended for children under 3 years. In other food-contact plastics the specific
migration limit is 0.05 milligrams per kilogram of food.

metadata.doc_title: Restricted Substances in Food-Contact Materials and Toys
metadata.category: Food Contact, Toys and Juvenile Products

text:
Restricted Substances in Food-Contact Materials and Toys > 1. Food-Contact Materials > RSR-005-C4 Melamine and Formaldehyde

The specific migration limits are 2.5 milligrams per kilogram for melamine and 15
milligrams per kilogram for formaldehyde. Bamboo-melamine composite tableware is
prohibited because the plant-fibre filler is not an authorised additive.

metadata.doc_title: Restricted Substances in Food-Contact Materials and Toys
metadata.category: Food Contact, Toys and Juvenile Products

text:
Restricted Substances in Food-Contact Materials and Toys > 1. Food-Contact Materials > RSR-005-C5 Declaration of Compliance

Every food-contact article shall be accompanied by a declaration of compliance and shall
bear the glass-and-fork symbol or the words "for food contact".

metadata.doc_title: Restricted Substances in Food-Contact Materials and Toys
metadata.category: Food Contact, Toys and Juvenile Products

text:
Restricted Substances in Food-Contact Materials and Toys > 2. Toys > RSR-005-C6 Element Migration Limits

Migration from toy materials shall not exceed the limits for the 19 regulated elements.
The limits differ by material class: dry brittle powdery or pliable material, liquid or
sticky material, and scraped-off material. Scraped-off material carries the strictest
limits, for example 2.0 milligrams per kilogram for lead.

metadata.doc_title: Restricted Substances in Food-Contact Materials and Toys
metadata.category: Food Contact, Toys and Juvenile Products

text:
Restricted Substances in Food-Contact Materials and Toys > 2. Toys > RSR-005-C7 Fragrances in Toys

The 55 prohibited allergenic fragrances shall not be used in toys. A further 11
fragrances shall be labelled where present above 100 milligrams per kilogram.

metadata.doc_title: Restricted Substances in Food-Contact Materials and Toys
metadata.category: Food Contact, Toys and Juvenile Products

text:
Restricted Substances in Food-Contact Materials and Toys > 2. Toys > RSR-005-C8 Finger Paints and Cosmetic Toys

Finger paints, modelling clay, and cosmetic toy sets are subject to the strictest
element migration class and shall carry the age grade and the instruction not to be
ingested.

metadata.doc_title: Restricted Substances in Food-Contact Materials and Toys
metadata.category: Food Contact, Toys and Juvenile Products

text:
Restricted Substances in Food-Contact Materials and Toys > 2. Toys > RSR-005-C9 Nitrosamines

Nitrosamines and nitrosatable substances shall not be present above 0.05 and 1
milligrams per kilogram respectively in elastomer toy parts intended for children under
36 months or intended to be placed in the mouth.

metadata.doc_title: Restricted Substances in Food-Contact Materials and Toys
metadata.category: Food Contact, Toys and Juvenile Products

text:
Restricted Substances in Food-Contact Materials and Toys > 2. Toys > RSR-005-C10 Evidence

Toy chemical test reports shall accompany the category approval application under
CAT-003-C2 and are subject to the production requirement in RSR-001-C9.

metadata.doc_title: Restricted Substances in Food-Contact Materials and Toys
metadata.category: Food Contact, Toys and Juvenile Products

text:
Substance Disclosure Obligations and Restricted Marketing Claims > 1. Substance of Concern Disclosure > RSR-006-C1 Candidate List Disclosure Duty

Where an article contains a substance of very high concern above 0.1 percent by weight of
the article, the seller shall disclose the substance name and safe-use instructions to
the buyer, free of charge, and shall record the disclosure in the compliance attributes.

metadata.doc_title: Substance Disclosure Obligations and Restricted Marketing Claims

text:
Substance Disclosure Obligations and Restricted Marketing Claims > 1. Substance of Concern Disclosure > RSR-006-C2 Article Basis

The 0.1 percent threshold applies to each article in a complex product, not to the
assembled product as a whole. A single component above the threshold triggers the duty
for the whole listing.

metadata.doc_title: Substance Disclosure Obligations and Restricted Marketing Claims

text:
Substance Disclosure Obligations and Restricted Marketing Claims > 1. Substance of Concern Disclosure > RSR-006-C3 Disclosure Timing

Disclosure shall be available at the point of sale in the listing and shall not be
deferred to post-purchase documentation.

metadata.doc_title: Substance Disclosure Obligations and Restricted Marketing Claims

text:
Substance Disclosure Obligations and Restricted Marketing Claims > 2. Restricted Marketing Claims > RSR-006-C4 Free-From Claims

"Free from" claims are permitted only where the substance is genuinely absent, the
substance is one a buyer could reasonably expect to be present, and the claim does not
imply that products containing the substance are unsafe when they are lawfully
compliant. "Chemical-free" is prohibited in all cases.

metadata.doc_title: Substance Disclosure Obligations and Restricted Marketing Claims

text:
Substance Disclosure Obligations and Restricted Marketing Claims > 2. Restricted Marketing Claims > RSR-006-C5 Non-Toxic and Natural Claims

"Non-toxic" is prohibited unless accompanied by the named standard against which
toxicity was assessed. "Natural" and "pure" require a stated definition and a percentage
of natural-origin content.

metadata.doc_title: Substance Disclosure Obligations and Restricted Marketing Claims

text:
Substance Disclosure Obligations and Restricted Marketing Claims > 2. Restricted Marketing Claims > RSR-006-C6 Hypoallergenic Claims

"Hypoallergenic" requires evidence of reduced allergen content relative to a comparable
product and shall not be presented as a guarantee that no reaction will occur.

metadata.doc_title: Substance Disclosure Obligations and Restricted Marketing Claims

text:
Substance Disclosure Obligations and Restricted Marketing Claims > 2. Restricted Marketing Claims > RSR-006-C7 Environmental Claims

Claims such as "biodegradable", "compostable", "recyclable", and "carbon neutral" require
a named standard, the conditions under which the claim holds, and the scope of the
product to which it applies. Unqualified environmental claims are prohibited under
CLS-002-C9.

metadata.doc_title: Substance Disclosure Obligations and Restricted Marketing Claims

text:
Substance Disclosure Obligations and Restricted Marketing Claims > 3. Enforcement and Guidance > RSR-006-C8 Evidence Standard

Claims under this document are substantiated by test report, certification, or an
accredited assessment. A supplier's marketing material is not substantiation.

metadata.doc_title: Substance Disclosure Obligations and Restricted Marketing Claims

text:
Substance Disclosure Obligations and Restricted Marketing Claims > 3. Enforcement and Guidance > RSR-006-C9 Withdrawal of Claim

Where substantiation is not produced within 10 business days, the seller shall remove the
claim. Removal of the claim resolves the defect; it does not resolve any separate
substance limit breach.

metadata.doc_title: Substance Disclosure Obligations and Restricted Marketing Claims

text:
Substance Disclosure Obligations and Restricted Marketing Claims > 3. Enforcement and Guidance > RSR-006-C10 Policy Position Only

Findings under this document express the marketplace's catalog policy position. They are
not a regulatory determination and do not constitute legal advice on the seller's
obligations in any jurisdiction.

metadata.doc_title: Substance Disclosure Obligations and Restricted Marketing Claims

text:
General Product Safety Requirements > 1. General Obligation > SAF-001-C1 Safe Product Obligation

Every product offered shall be a safe product: under normal or reasonably foreseeable
conditions of use, including duration of use and the needs of vulnerable user groups, it
shall present no risk or only the minimum risk compatible with the product's use.

metadata.doc_title: General Product Safety Requirements

text:
General Product Safety Requirements > 1. General Obligation > SAF-001-C2 Reasonably Foreseeable Misuse

Assessment of safety shall account for reasonably foreseeable misuse, particularly by
children, older users, and users with disabilities, and not only for use strictly in
accordance with the instructions.

metadata.doc_title: General Product Safety Requirements

text:
General Product Safety Requirements > 2. Economic Operator Identification > SAF-001-C3 Responsible Person Requirement

Each listing shall identify an economic operator established in the storefront
jurisdiction who is responsible for the product's compliance. The operator's name and
postal address shall appear on the product, on its packaging, or in an accompanying
document.

metadata.doc_title: General Product Safety Requirements

text:
General Product Safety Requirements > 2. Economic Operator Identification > SAF-001-C4 Listing Disclosure of Operator

The economic operator's name and contact address shall be reproduced in the listing's
compliance attribute fields. Absence of this information is a Tier 1 defect for any
product in an approval-gated category.

metadata.doc_title: General Product Safety Requirements

text:
General Product Safety Requirements > 3. Instructions and Warnings > SAF-001-C5 Instructions Requirement

Products shall be supplied with instructions and safety information in the official
language of the storefront jurisdiction. Instructions supplied only in a foreign
language are a Tier 1 defect.

metadata.doc_title: General Product Safety Requirements

text:
General Product Safety Requirements > 3. Instructions and Warnings > SAF-001-C6 Warning Prominence

Safety warnings shall be legible, indelible, and reproduced in the listing where the
warning concerns a hazard that would influence a purchase decision, including choking,
strangulation, burn, ingestion, electrical, and chemical hazards.

metadata.doc_title: General Product Safety Requirements

text:
General Product Safety Requirements > 3. Instructions and Warnings > SAF-001-C7 Warning Placement in Listings

A required safety warning shall appear within the first three bullet features and shall
not be placed solely in the long description or solely in an image.

metadata.doc_title: General Product Safety Requirements

text:
General Product Safety Requirements > 4. Traceability and Recall > SAF-001-C8 Batch Traceability

Products shall carry a type, batch, serial, or model reference enabling identification.
Where the product is too small, the reference shall appear on the packaging.

metadata.doc_title: General Product Safety Requirements

text:
General Product Safety Requirements > 4. Traceability and Recall > SAF-001-C9 Recall Cooperation

On notification of a safety issue, the seller shall within 48 hours suspend the listing,
provide sales volume data for the affected batches, and cooperate with corrective action.

metadata.doc_title: General Product Safety Requirements

text:
General Product Safety Requirements > 4. Traceability and Recall > SAF-001-C10 Incident Reporting

A seller aware that a product it supplied is dangerous shall report the incident through
the marketplace safety portal within 48 hours of becoming aware.

metadata.doc_title: General Product Safety Requirements

text:
Choking, Ingestion and Mechanical Hazard Labeling Requirements > 1. Small Parts > SAF-002-C1 Small Part Definition

A small part is any component, including a component that detaches under the standard
use and abuse tests, that fits entirely within a cylinder of 31.7 millimetres diameter
and 57.1 millimetres depth measured at the shallowest point.

metadata.doc_title: Choking, Ingestion and Mechanical Hazard Labeling Requirements

text:
Choking, Ingestion and Mechanical Hazard Labeling Requirements > 1. Small Parts > SAF-002-C2 Under 36 Months Prohibition

A toy intended for children under 36 months shall not contain, and shall not be capable
of generating, a small part. Such a product may not be listed for that age group. This
is an absolute prohibition, not a labelling obligation.

metadata.doc_title: Choking, Ingestion and Mechanical Hazard Labeling Requirements

text:
Choking, Ingestion and Mechanical Hazard Labeling Requirements > 1. Small Parts > SAF-002-C3 Over 36 Months Labelling Obligation

A toy intended for children of 36 months and over that contains a small part shall carry
a choking hazard warning on the packaging and in the listing.

metadata.doc_title: Choking, Ingestion and Mechanical Hazard Labeling Requirements

text:
Choking, Ingestion and Mechanical Hazard Labeling Requirements > 1. Small Parts > SAF-002-C4 Required Choking Warning Text

The warning shall read: "WARNING: CHOKING HAZARD — Small parts. Not for children under
3 years." The signal word shall be in uppercase. The warning shall be accompanied by the
age-restriction symbol where the packaging permits.

metadata.doc_title: Choking, Ingestion and Mechanical Hazard Labeling Requirements

text:
Choking, Ingestion and Mechanical Hazard Labeling Requirements > 2. Balloons, Marbles and Small Balls > SAF-002-C5 Additional Hazard Classes

Latex balloons, marbles, and small balls under 44.5 millimetres carry a mandatory
warning irrespective of the declared age grade. The latex balloon warning shall
additionally state that children under 8 years can choke or suffocate on uninflated or
broken balloons and that adult supervision is required.

metadata.doc_title: Choking, Ingestion and Mechanical Hazard Labeling Requirements

text:
Choking, Ingestion and Mechanical Hazard Labeling Requirements > 3. Magnets > SAF-002-C6 Magnetic Flux Threshold

A loose or detachable magnet, or a magnetic component that is a small part, shall not
have a magnetic flux index of 50 kG²mm² or greater. Products exceeding this threshold
are prohibited in toys and in novelty products marketed to any age group.

metadata.doc_title: Choking, Ingestion and Mechanical Hazard Labeling Requirements

text:
Choking, Ingestion and Mechanical Hazard Labeling Requirements > 3. Magnets > SAF-002-C7 Magnet Ingestion Warning

Where magnets are permitted, the listing shall carry the warning that swallowing more
than one magnet may cause serious or fatal internal injury and that immediate medical
attention is required.

metadata.doc_title: Choking, Ingestion and Mechanical Hazard Labeling Requirements

text:
Choking, Ingestion and Mechanical Hazard Labeling Requirements > 4. Other Mechanical Hazards > SAF-002-C8 Strangulation Hazard

Cords, straps, and loops with a free length exceeding 220 millimetres on a product
intended for children under 3 require a strangulation warning under CAT-003-C8.

metadata.doc_title: Choking, Ingestion and Mechanical Hazard Labeling Requirements

text:
Choking, Ingestion and Mechanical Hazard Labeling Requirements > 4. Other Mechanical Hazards > SAF-002-C9 Sharp Edges and Points

Products intended for children shall not present accessible sharp edges or points beyond
those inherent to the product's function, and where inherent, the function shall be
disclosed with an age restriction.

metadata.doc_title: Choking, Ingestion and Mechanical Hazard Labeling Requirements

text:
Choking, Ingestion and Mechanical Hazard Labeling Requirements > 4. Other Mechanical Hazards > SAF-002-C10 Expanding Materials

Products containing materials that expand more than 50 percent in any dimension on
contact with water are prohibited where any component is a small part.

metadata.doc_title: Choking, Ingestion and Mechanical Hazard Labeling Requirements

text:
Battery and Electrical Safety Labeling Requirements > 1. Lithium Cells and Batteries > SAF-003-C1 Declaration Requirement

Any product containing or shipped with a lithium cell or battery shall declare cell
chemistry, cell count, watt-hour rating, and whether the cell is contained in the
equipment, packed with the equipment, or supplied loose.

metadata.doc_title: Battery and Electrical Safety Labeling Requirements

text:
Battery and Electrical Safety Labeling Requirements > 1. Lithium Cells and Batteries > SAF-003-C2 Watt-Hour Threshold

Lithium-ion cells exceeding 20 watt-hours per cell, or batteries exceeding 100
watt-hours, are restricted and require transport documentation with the category
approval. Loose lithium-ion cells above 20 watt-hours may not be sold to consumers.

metadata.doc_title: Battery and Electrical Safety Labeling Requirements

text:
Battery and Electrical Safety Labeling Requirements > 1. Lithium Cells and Batteries > SAF-003-C3 Transport Classification

Lithium batteries shall be flagged as dangerous goods under CLS-004-C8 with the
applicable transport classification and packing instruction reference.

metadata.doc_title: Battery and Electrical Safety Labeling Requirements

text:
Battery and Electrical Safety Labeling Requirements > 1. Lithium Cells and Batteries > SAF-003-C4 Damaged Cell Prohibition

Damaged, swollen, recalled, or reclaimed lithium cells may not be listed under any
circumstance.

metadata.doc_title: Battery and Electrical Safety Labeling Requirements

text:
Battery and Electrical Safety Labeling Requirements > 2. Button and Coin Cells > SAF-003-C5 Scope of Button Cell Rules

These clauses apply to any consumer product containing a button or coin cell of 32
millimetres diameter or less, including toys, remote controls, greeting cards, novelty
lights, thermometers, and hearing aid accessories.

metadata.doc_title: Battery and Electrical Safety Labeling Requirements

text:
Battery and Electrical Safety Labeling Requirements > 2. Button and Coin Cells > SAF-003-C6 Secured Compartment Requirement

The battery compartment shall be secured such that it cannot be opened without a tool,
or requires two independent and simultaneous movements to open. A compartment openable
by hand in a single motion is a Tier 1 safety defect.

metadata.doc_title: Battery and Electrical Safety Labeling Requirements

text:
Battery and Electrical Safety Labeling Requirements > 2. Button and Coin Cells > SAF-003-C7 Required Button Cell Warning

The product, its packaging, and the listing shall carry the warning: "WARNING: INGESTION
HAZARD — This product contains a button or coin cell battery. Swallowing can lead to
chemical burns, perforation of soft tissue, and death. Seek immediate medical attention."
The warning shall also state to keep batteries out of reach of children and to dispose of
used batteries immediately.

metadata.doc_title: Battery and Electrical Safety Labeling Requirements

text:
Battery and Electrical Safety Labeling Requirements > 3. Mains Electrical Safety > SAF-003-C8 Conformity Marking

Mains-powered products shall carry the conformity marking required by the storefront
jurisdiction and shall reference the applicable safety standard in the compliance
attributes.

metadata.doc_title: Battery and Electrical Safety Labeling Requirements

text:
Battery and Electrical Safety Labeling Requirements > 3. Mains Electrical Safety > SAF-003-C9 Insulation Class and Ingress Rating

Products shall declare their insulation class and, where marketed for outdoor or
bathroom use, their ingress protection rating.

metadata.doc_title: Battery and Electrical Safety Labeling Requirements

text:
Battery and Electrical Safety Labeling Requirements > 3. Mains Electrical Safety > SAF-003-C10 Charger and Adapter Requirements

Supplied chargers shall bear the conformity marking, shall declare output voltage and
current, and shall not be substituted for a non-original adapter without disclosure in
the listing.

metadata.doc_title: Battery and Electrical Safety Labeling Requirements

text:
Dangerous Goods Classification and Transport Requirements > 1. Classification > SAF-004-C1 Definition of Dangerous Goods

Dangerous goods are articles or substances capable of posing a risk to health, safety,
property, or the environment during transport, and which are classified under the
applicable transport regulations.

metadata.doc_title: Dangerous Goods Classification and Transport Requirements

text:
Dangerous Goods Classification and Transport Requirements > 1. Classification > SAF-004-C2 Common Marketplace Classes

The classes most frequently encountered are: flammable liquids such as perfumes,
solvents and nail products; flammable solids; oxidising substances; toxic substances;
corrosive substances such as drain cleaners and battery acid; lithium batteries; and
aerosols under pressure.

metadata.doc_title: Dangerous Goods Classification and Transport Requirements

text:
Dangerous Goods Classification and Transport Requirements > 1. Classification > SAF-004-C3 Seller Classification Duty

The seller is responsible for correctly classifying the product before listing. Where
the seller is uncertain, the safety data sheet section 14 provides the transport
classification.

metadata.doc_title: Dangerous Goods Classification and Transport Requirements

text:
Dangerous Goods Classification and Transport Requirements > 2. Declaration Obligations > SAF-004-C4 Mandatory Fulfilment Flag

Every dangerous good shall carry the hazardous goods fulfilment flag with the UN number,
proper shipping name, class, and packing group where assigned. Omission is a Tier 1
defect under CLS-004-C8 and blocks fulfilment-centre intake.

metadata.doc_title: Dangerous Goods Classification and Transport Requirements

text:
Dangerous Goods Classification and Transport Requirements > 2. Declaration Obligations > SAF-004-C5 Limited Quantity and Excepted Quantity

Where a product ships under a limited quantity or excepted quantity provision, the
listing shall record the provision relied upon and the per-package quantity limit.

metadata.doc_title: Dangerous Goods Classification and Transport Requirements

text:
Dangerous Goods Classification and Transport Requirements > 2. Declaration Obligations > SAF-004-C6 Air Transport Restrictions

Products forbidden for passenger aircraft transport shall be flagged as surface-only.
Listings without this flag may be routed to air freight, which is a transport safety
breach attributable to the seller.

metadata.doc_title: Dangerous Goods Classification and Transport Requirements

text:
Dangerous Goods Classification and Transport Requirements > 3. Packaging and Labelling > SAF-004-C7 Outer Packaging Marks

Dangerous goods shall be supplied in packaging bearing the applicable hazard label,
orientation arrows where required, and the UN specification marking where the packing
group requires performance-tested packaging.

metadata.doc_title: Dangerous Goods Classification and Transport Requirements

text:
Dangerous Goods Classification and Transport Requirements > 3. Packaging and Labelling > SAF-004-C8 Overpack Rules

Where multiple dangerous goods are consolidated, the overpack shall reproduce every
applicable hazard label and shall be marked "OVERPACK".

metadata.doc_title: Dangerous Goods Classification and Transport Requirements

text:
Dangerous Goods Classification and Transport Requirements > 3. Packaging and Labelling > SAF-004-C9 Quantity Limits Per Consignment

Consumer consignments shall not exceed the marketplace's per-consignment net quantity
limit for the class. Splitting a single order across consignments to evade the limit is
prohibited.

metadata.doc_title: Dangerous Goods Classification and Transport Requirements

text:
Dangerous Goods Classification and Transport Requirements > 3. Packaging and Labelling > SAF-004-C10 Prohibited Transport Items

Explosives, infectious substances, radioactive material, and self-reactive substances
may not be listed and are prohibited under CLS-006-C2.

metadata.doc_title: Dangerous Goods Classification and Transport Requirements

text:
Flammability Requirements for Textiles and Furnishings > 1. Children's Sleepwear > SAF-005-C1 Scope of Sleepwear Rules

These clauses apply to nightdresses, dressing gowns, pyjamas, and bathrobes intended for
children from 3 months to 13 years, and to adult nightdresses and dressing gowns.

metadata.doc_title: Flammability Requirements for Textiles and Furnishings

text:
Flammability Requirements for Textiles and Furnishings > 1. Children's Sleepwear > SAF-005-C2 Performance or Warning

Children's nightwear shall either meet the low-flammability performance requirement of
the applicable standard, or, where it does not, carry the permanent warning label
"KEEP AWAY FROM FIRE". Pyjamas that fail the performance requirement shall carry the
warning; nightdresses and dressing gowns that fail the requirement may not be supplied
for children.

metadata.doc_title: Flammability Requirements for Textiles and Furnishings

text:
Flammability Requirements for Textiles and Furnishings > 1. Children's Sleepwear > SAF-005-C3 Label Permanence and Placement

The flammability warning shall be permanently attached, legible after the number of wash
cycles specified in the care instructions, and located where it is visible at the point
of sale on the packaging or a swing ticket.

metadata.doc_title: Flammability Requirements for Textiles and Furnishings

text:
Flammability Requirements for Textiles and Furnishings > 1. Children's Sleepwear > SAF-005-C4 Listing Reproduction

Where a garment carries a flammability warning, the listing shall reproduce the warning
in the first three bullet features under SAF-001-C7 and shall display the warning label
in a secondary image.

metadata.doc_title: Flammability Requirements for Textiles and Furnishings

text:
Flammability Requirements for Textiles and Furnishings > 2. Upholstered Furniture > SAF-005-C5 Filling and Covering Requirements

Upholstered furniture and loose covers shall meet the cigarette and match ignition
resistance requirements applicable to filling materials and covering fabrics.

metadata.doc_title: Flammability Requirements for Textiles and Furnishings

text:
Flammability Requirements for Textiles and Furnishings > 2. Upholstered Furniture > SAF-005-C6 Permanent Label Requirement

Upholstered items shall carry the permanent flammability label and, at point of sale,
the display label stating that the item meets the ignition resistance requirements.

metadata.doc_title: Flammability Requirements for Textiles and Furnishings

text:
Flammability Requirements for Textiles and Furnishings > 3. Other Textiles > SAF-005-C7 Fancy Dress and Costumes

Children's fancy dress costumes are treated as toys for flammability purposes and shall
meet the toy flammability requirement, with the rate of flame spread declared.

metadata.doc_title: Flammability Requirements for Textiles and Furnishings

text:
Flammability Requirements for Textiles and Furnishings > 3. Other Textiles > SAF-005-C8 Candles and Wicks

Candles shall declare burn time, shall carry the fire safety warning to never leave a
burning candle unattended and to keep away from children and pets, and shall confirm the
wick contains no lead core.

metadata.doc_title: Flammability Requirements for Textiles and Furnishings

text:
Flammability Requirements for Textiles and Furnishings > 3. Other Textiles > SAF-005-C9 Camping and Outdoor Textiles

Tents and sleeping bags shall declare the flammability standard met and shall carry the
warning against using fuel-burning appliances inside.

metadata.doc_title: Flammability Requirements for Textiles and Furnishings

text:
Flammability Requirements for Textiles and Furnishings > 3. Other Textiles > SAF-005-C10 Substantiation

Flammability test reports shall be retained for the product's commercial life plus five
years and produced within 10 business days of request under CLS-002-C8.

metadata.doc_title: Flammability Requirements for Textiles and Furnishings

text:
Label Format, Legibility and Language Requirements > 1. Legibility > SAF-006-C1 Minimum Type Size

Mandatory label information shall be printed at a minimum x-height of 1.2 millimetres.
Where the largest package surface is less than 80 square centimetres, the minimum
x-height is reduced to 0.9 millimetres.

metadata.doc_title: Label Format, Legibility and Language Requirements

text:
Label Format, Legibility and Language Requirements > 1. Legibility > SAF-006-C2 Contrast and Durability

Label text shall contrast clearly with its background and shall be indelible under
normal conditions of use, including expected exposure to moisture and abrasion.

metadata.doc_title: Label Format, Legibility and Language Requirements

text:
Label Format, Legibility and Language Requirements > 1. Legibility > SAF-006-C3 No Obscuring

Mandatory information shall not be obscured by promotional stickers, price labels,
shrink wrap seams, or the packaging fold.

metadata.doc_title: Label Format, Legibility and Language Requirements

text:
Label Format, Legibility and Language Requirements > 2. Warning Format > SAF-006-C4 Signal Word Hierarchy

Warnings shall use the signal word appropriate to the severity: "DANGER" for a hazard
that will result in death or serious injury, "WARNING" for a hazard that could result in
death or serious injury, and "CAUTION" for a hazard that could result in minor injury.

metadata.doc_title: Label Format, Legibility and Language Requirements

text:
Label Format, Legibility and Language Requirements > 2. Warning Format > SAF-006-C5 Warning Structure

A compliant warning states the signal word, the nature of the hazard, the consequence of
exposure, and the action the user must take to avoid it, in that order.

metadata.doc_title: Label Format, Legibility and Language Requirements

text:
Label Format, Legibility and Language Requirements > 2. Warning Format > SAF-006-C6 Pictogram Use

Where a pictogram is prescribed it shall be reproduced at no less than 10 millimetres per
side and shall not be redrawn, recoloured, or stylised.

metadata.doc_title: Label Format, Legibility and Language Requirements

text:
Label Format, Legibility and Language Requirements > 3. Language > SAF-006-C7 Official Language Requirement

All mandatory safety information shall appear in the official language of the storefront
jurisdiction. Multilingual labels are permitted provided each language carries the
complete mandatory information.

metadata.doc_title: Label Format, Legibility and Language Requirements

text:
Label Format, Legibility and Language Requirements > 3. Language > SAF-006-C8 Translation Accuracy

Translations shall preserve the meaning and severity of the original. A translation that
downgrades a signal word or omits a consequence statement is a Tier 1 defect.

metadata.doc_title: Label Format, Legibility and Language Requirements

text:
Label Format, Legibility and Language Requirements > 3. Language > SAF-006-C9 Over-Labelling

An over-label applied to correct or translate original packaging shall be permanently
affixed, shall not obscure other mandatory information, and shall meet the same
legibility requirements as printed text.

metadata.doc_title: Label Format, Legibility and Language Requirements

text:
Label Format, Legibility and Language Requirements > 4. Digital Labels > SAF-006-C10 Electronic Label Limits

A digital or QR-linked label may supplement but shall never replace mandatory physical
safety information, warnings, or the economic operator identification.
